    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def plot_best_scores(best_scores_ran, excel_file_path):\n",
    "    # Extract the best pruner for each model based on RMSE and correlation coefficient\n",
    "    best_rmse_scores = {}\n",
    "    best_corr_coef_scores = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "    for (model_name, pruner_name), scores in best_scores_ran.items():\n",
    "        # Initialize if not already present\n",
    "        if model_name not in best_rmse_scores:\n",
    "            best_rmse_scores[model_name] = (scores['test_rmse'], pruner_name)\n",
    "        if model_name not in best_corr_coef_scores:\n",
    "            best_corr_coef_scores[model_name] = (scores['test_corr_coef'], pruner_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Update if better scores are found\n",
    "        if scores['test_rmse'] < best_rmse_scores[model_name][0]:\n",
    "            best_rmse_scores[model_name] = (scores['test_rmse'], pruner_name)\n",
    "        if scores['test_corr_coef'] > best_corr_coef_scores[model_name][0]:\n",
    "            best_corr_coef_scores[model_name] = (scores['test_corr_coef'], pruner_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Prepare data for plotting\n",
    "    model_names_rmse = [f\"{model} ({pruner})\" for model, (rmse, pruner) in best_rmse_scores.items()]\n",
    "    rmse_values = [rmse for rmse, _ in best_rmse_scores.values()]\n",
    "\n",
    "    model_names_corr = [f\"{model} ({pruner})\" for model, (corr, pruner) in best_corr_coef_scores.items()]\n",
    "    corr_values = [corr for corr, _ in best_corr_coef_scores.values()]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot RMSE\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
    "    bars_rmse = plt.bar(model_names_rmse, rmse_values, color='skyblue')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Highlight the best model\n",
    "    best_rmse_index = np.argmin(rmse_values)\n",
    "    bars_rmse[best_rmse_index].set_color('orange')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Annotate the bars with the RMSE scores\n",
    "    for i, bar in enumerate(bars_rmse):\n",
    "        plt.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() - 0.05,\n",
    "                 f'{rmse_values[i]:.5f}', ha='center', va='bottom', color='black')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add labels and title for the RMSE bar chart\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Model (Pruner)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Test RMSE')\n",
    "    plt.title('Best Test RMSE for Each Model')\n",
    "    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    rmse_image_path = 'rmse_plot.png'\n",
    "    _ensure_parent_dir(rmse_image_path)\n",
    "    plt.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(rmse_image_path))\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot Correlation Coefficient\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
    "    bars_corr = plt.bar(model_names_corr, corr_values, color='lightgreen')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Highlight the best model\n",
    "    best_corr_index = np.argmax(corr_values)\n",
    "    bars_corr[best_corr_index].set_color('orange')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Annotate the bars with the correlation coefficient scores\n",
    "    for i, bar in enumerate(bars_corr):\n",
    "        plt.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() - 0.05,\n",
    "                 f'{corr_values[i]:.5f}', ha='center', va='bottom', color='black')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add labels and title for the correlation coefficient bar chart\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Model (Pruner)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Correlation Coefficient')\n",
    "    plt.title('Best Correlation Coefficient for Each Model')\n",
    "    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    corr_image_path = 'corr_plot.png'\n",
    "    _ensure_parent_dir(corr_image_path)\n",
    "    plt.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(corr_image_path))\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Load the existing Excel file\n",
    "    workbook = load_workbook(_ensure_excel_file(excel_file_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create a new sheet for the plots\n",
    "    sheet_name = 'Best Models Plots'\n",
    "    if sheet_name in workbook.sheetnames:\n",
    "        sheet = workbook[sheet_name]\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        sheet = workbook.create_sheet(title=sheet_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Insert images into the new Excel sheet\n",
    "    img_rmse = Image(rmse_image_path)\n",
    "    img_corr = Image(corr_image_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Insert images\n",
    "    sheet.add_image(img_rmse, 'A1')\n",
    "    sheet.add_image(img_corr, 'A20')  # Adjust the position as needed\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save the workbook\n",
    "    _ensure_parent_dir(excel_file_path)\n",
    "    workbook.save(_ensure_parent_dir(excel_file_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Clean up the image files\n",
    "    if os.path.exists(str(rmse_image_path)): os.remove(str(rmse_image_path))\n",
    "    if os.path.exists(str(corr_image_path)): os.remove(str(corr_image_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Example usage\n",
    "# plot_best_scores(best_scores_ran, 'path_to_your_excel_file.xlsx')"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_interpretml_explanations_summary_pruners(\n",
    "    results_dict, X_train, y_train, X_test, feature_names, instance_indices=None, excel_file_path=None\n",
    "):\n",
    "    if instance_indices is None:\n",
    "        instance_indices = range(len(X_test))\n",
    "    elif isinstance(instance_indices, int):\n",
    "        instance_indices = [instance_indices]\n",
    "\n",
    "    valid_indices = [idx for idx in instance_indices if 0 <= idx < len(X_test)]\n",
    "    if not valid_indices:\n",
    "        print(\"No valid instance indices provided.\")\n",
    "        return\n",
    "\n",
    "    if isinstance(X_test, pd.DataFrame):\n",
    "        instances_to_explain = X_test.iloc[valid_indices]\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        instances_to_explain = X_test[valid_indices]\n",
    "\n",
    "    best_model_pruners = {}\n",
    "    for model_key, model_info in results_dict.items():\n",
    "        if isinstance(model_key, tuple):\n",
    "            model_name, pruner_name = model_key\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            model_name = model_key\n",
    "            pruner_name = None\n",
    "\n",
    "        best_score = model_info.get('best_score')\n",
    "        if best_score is None:\n",
    "            print(f\"No 'best_score' found for {model_key}. Skipping this combination.\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        if model_name not in best_model_pruners:\n",
    "            best_model_pruners[model_name] = {\n",
    "                'pruner_name': pruner_name,\n",
    "                'model_info': model_info,\n",
    "                'best_score': best_score\n",
    "            }\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            current_best_score = best_model_pruners[model_name]['best_score']\n",
    "            if best_score < current_best_score:\n",
    "                best_model_pruners[model_name] = {\n",
    "                    'pruner_name': pruner_name,\n",
    "                    'model_info': model_info,\n",
    "                    'best_score': best_score\n",
    "                }\n",
    "\n",
    "    for model_name, info in best_model_pruners.items():\n",
    "        pruner_name = info['pruner_name']\n",
    "        model_info = info['model_info']\n",
    "        best_params = dict(model_info['best_params'])  # don't mutate original!\n",
    "        model_class = model_classes.get(model_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if model_class is None:\n",
    "            print(f\"Model {model_name} is not supported or not available.\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        if model_name == 'CatBoost':\n",
    "            best_params['verbose'] = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ------- Main model fit logic ---------\n",
    "        if model_name == \"TabNet\":\n",
    "            # TabNet: reshape y, fit, flatten pred for LIME/SHAP, etc.\n",
    "            y_train_tabnet = np.array(y_train).reshape(-1, 1)\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                model = model_class(**{k: v for k, v in best_params.items() if k != \"verbose\"})\n",
    "            except TypeError:\n",
    "                model = model_class()\n",
    "            model.fit(np.array(X_train), y_train_tabnet, max_epochs=100, patience=10, batch_size=1024, eval_set=[(np.array(X_train), y_train_tabnet)])\n",
    "            def predict_fn(data):\n",
    "                preds = model.predict(np.array(data))\n",
    "                # flatten for interpreters\n",
    "                return preds.flatten()\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                model = model_class(**best_params)\n",
    "            except TypeError:\n",
    "                model = model_class()\n",
    "            model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "            def predict_fn(data):\n",
    "                return model.predict(data)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if isinstance(X_train, pd.DataFrame):\n",
    "            data_for_explainer = X_train.values\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            data_for_explainer = X_train\n",
    "\n",
    "        if isinstance(instances_to_explain, pd.DataFrame):\n",
    "            data_for_explanation = instances_to_explain.values\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            data_for_explanation = instances_to_explain\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Generate LIME explanations\n",
    "        lime_explainer = LimeTabular(\n",
    "            predict_fn,\n",
    "            data=data_for_explainer,\n",
    "            feature_names=feature_names,\n",
    "            random_state=1,\n",
    "            mode='regression'\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        lime_explanation = lime_explainer.explain_local(data_for_explanation)\n",
    "\n",
    "        feature_importances_lime = {}\n",
    "        num_instances = len(valid_indices)\n",
    "        for idx in range(num_instances):\n",
    "            explanation = lime_explanation.data(idx)\n",
    "            for feature_name, feature_score in zip(explanation['names'], explanation['scores']):\n",
    "                feature_importances_lime[feature_name] = feature_importances_lime.get(feature_name, 0) + abs(feature_score)\n",
    "        feature_importances_lime = {k: v / num_instances for k, v in feature_importances_lime.items()}\n",
    "        feature_importances_lime = {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in feature_importances_lime.items()}\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Generate SHAP explanations using ShapKernel\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            shap_explainer = ShapKernel(predict_fn, data_for_explainer, feature_names=feature_names)\n",
    "            shap_explanation = shap_explainer.explain_local(data_for_explanation)\n",
    "\n",
    "            feature_importances_shap = {}\n",
    "            for idx in range(num_instances):\n",
    "                explanation = shap_explanation.data(idx)\n",
    "                for feature_name, feature_score in zip(explanation['names'], explanation['scores']):\n",
    "                    feature_importances_shap[feature_name] = feature_importances_shap.get(feature_name, 0) + abs(feature_score)\n",
    "\n",
    "            feature_importances_shap = {k: v / num_instances for k, v in feature_importances_shap.items()}\n",
    "            feature_importances_shap = {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in feature_importances_shap.items()}\n",
    "        except Exception as e:\n",
    "            print(f\"Could not compute SHAP values for model {model_name}: {e}\")\n",
    "            feature_importances_shap = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Plot LIME and SHAP feature importances side by side\n",
    "        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(34, 36))\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Plot LIME feature importances\n",
    "        lime_importances_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(\n",
    "            feature_importances_lime, orient='index', columns=['importance']\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        lime_importances_df.sort_values(by='importance', ascending=False, inplace=True)\n",
    "        lime_importances_df.plot(kind='bar', legend=False, color='skyblue', ax=axes[0])\n",
    "        axes[0].set_title(f\"LIME Feature Importances for {model_name}\")\n",
    "        axes[0].set_ylabel(\"Average Absolute Importance Score\")\n",
    "        axes[0].set_xlabel(\"Features\")\n",
    "        axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)\n",
    "\n",
    "        for p in axes[0].patches:\n",
    "            height = p.get_height()\n",
    "            axes[0].annotate(f'{height:.3f}',\n",
    "                             (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., height),\n",
    "                             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Plot SHAP feature importances\n",
    "        shap_importances_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(\n",
    "            feature_importances_shap, orient='index', columns=['importance']\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        shap_importances_df.sort_values(by='importance', ascending=False, inplace=True)\n",
    "        shap_importances_df.plot(kind='bar', legend=False, color='orange', ax=axes[1])\n",
    "        axes[1].set_title(f\"SHAP Feature Importances for {model_name}\")\n",
    "        axes[1].set_ylabel(\"Average Absolute SHAP Value\")\n",
    "        axes[1].set_xlabel(\"Features\")\n",
    "        axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)\n",
    "\n",
    "        for p in axes[1].patches:\n",
    "            height = p.get_height()\n",
    "            axes[1].annotate(f'{height:.3f}',\n",
    "                             (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., height),\n",
    "                             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Save plots as images\n",
    "        image_path = f'feature_importances_{model_name}.png'\n",
    "        fig.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(image_path))\n",
    "        plt.close(fig)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Optionally insert images and scores into an Excel file\n",
    "        if excel_file_path:\n",
    "            workbook = load_workbook(_ensure_excel_file(excel_file_path))\n",
    "            sheet_name = f'{model_name} Explanations'\n",
    "            if sheet_name in workbook.sheetnames:\n",
    "                sheet = workbook[sheet_name]\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                sheet = workbook.create_sheet(title=sheet_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Insert images into the new Excel sheet\n",
    "            img = Image(image_path)\n",
    "            sheet.add_image(img, 'A1')\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Create a new sheet for feature importance scores\n",
    "            scores_sheet_name = f'{model_name} Scores'\n",
    "            if scores_sheet_name in workbook.sheetnames:\n",
    "                scores_sheet = workbook[scores_sheet_name]\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                scores_sheet = workbook.create_sheet(title=scores_sheet_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Write LIME scores\n",
    "            scores_sheet.append(['Feature', 'LIME Importance'])\n",
    "            for feature, importance in feature_importances_lime.items():\n",
    "                scores_sheet.append([feature, importance])\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Write SHAP scores if available\n",
    "            if feature_importances_shap:\n",
    "                scores_sheet.append(['Feature', 'SHAP Importance'])\n",
    "                for feature, importance in feature_importances_shap.items():\n",
    "                    scores_sheet.append([feature, importance])\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Save the workbook\n",

   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "import joblib\n",
    "\n",
    "def mseloss_objective(yhat, y, sample_weight=None):\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(yhat):\n",
    "        yhat = torch.from_numpy(np.array(yhat)).float()\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(y):\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(np.array(y)).float()\n",
    "    gradient = yhat - y\n",
    "    hessian = torch.ones_like(yhat)\n",
    "    return gradient, hessian\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def rmseloss_metric(yhat, y, sample_weight=None):\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(yhat):\n",
    "        yhat = torch.from_numpy(np.array(yhat)).float()\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(y):\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(np.array(y)).float()\n",
    "    loss = torch.sqrt(torch.mean((yhat - y) ** 2))\n",
    "    return loss\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def hyperparameter_tuning_all(X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, excel_path):\n",
    "\n",
    "    X_train = np.array(X_train)\n",
    "    y_train = np.array(y_train)\n",
    "    X_test = np.array(X_test)\n",
    "    y_test = np.array(y_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ================= NEW =================\n",
    "    model_save_dir = \"./drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/hyperparameter_tuning/models\"\n",
    "    os.makedirs(model_save_dir, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    best_rmse_tracker = {}\n",
    "    # =======================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    models = {\n",
    "        'Random Forest': (RandomForestRegressor, {\n",
    "            'n_estimators': [100, 200, 300, 500, 700],\n",
    "            'criterion': ['squared_error', 'absolute_error', 'friedman_mse', 'poisson'],\n",
    "            'max_depth': [None, 10, 20, 30, 40],\n",
    "            'min_samples_split': [2, 5, 10, 0.01],\n",
    "            'min_samples_leaf': [1, 3, 5, 0.01],\n",
    "            'min_weight_fraction_leaf': [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 0.2],\n",
    "            'max_features': [1.0, 'sqrt', 'log2', 0.3, 0.5],\n",
    "            'max_leaf_nodes': [None, 50, 100, 200],\n",
    "            'min_impurity_decrease': [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 0.2],\n",
    "            'n_jobs': [-1],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'verbose': [0],\n",
    "            'warm_start': [False],\n",
    "            'ccp_alpha': [0.0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'Gradient Boosting': (GradientBoostingRegressor, {\n",
    "            'loss': ['squared_error', 'absolute_error', 'huber', 'quantile'],\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2],\n",
    "            'n_estimators': [100, 200, 300, 500, 700],\n",
    "            'subsample': [1.0, 0.9, 0.7, 0.5],\n",
    "            'criterion': ['friedman_mse', 'squared_error'],\n",
    "            'min_samples_split': [2, 5, 10, 0.01],\n",
    "            'min_samples_leaf': [1, 3, 5, 0.01],\n",
    "            'min_weight_fraction_leaf': [0.0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1],\n",
    "            'max_depth': [3, 5, 7, 10],\n",
    "            'min_impurity_decrease': [0.0, 0.01, 0.1],\n",
    "            'init': [None],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'max_features': [None, 'sqrt', 'log2', 0.5],\n",
    "            'alpha': [0.9, 0.5, 0.1],\n",
    "            'verbose': [0],\n",
    "            'max_leaf_nodes': [None, 10, 30, 50],\n",
    "            'warm_start': [False],\n",
    "            'validation_fraction': [0.1],\n",
    "            'n_iter_no_change': [None, 10, 20],\n",
    "            'tol': [1e-4, 1e-3],\n",
    "            'ccp_alpha': [0.0, 0.001, 0.01]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'XGBoost': (XGBRegressor, {\n",
    "            'n_estimators': [100, 200, 300, 400, 500],\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15],\n",
    "            'max_depth': [3, 5, 7],\n",
    "            'min_child_weight': [1, 3, 5],\n",
    "            'gamma': [0, 0.1, 0.5, 1],\n",
    "            'subsample': [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9],\n",
    "            'colsample_bytree': [0.5, 0.7, 0.9],\n",
    "            'colsample_bylevel': [0.5, 0.7, 0.9],\n",
    "            'reg_alpha': [0, 0.01, 0.1, 1],\n",
    "            'reg_lambda': [0.1, 1, 5, 10],\n",
    "            'objective': ['reg:squarederror'],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'n_jobs': [-1]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'LightGBM': (LGBMRegressor, {\n",
    "            'n_estimators': [100, 200, 300, 400, 500],\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15],\n",
    "            'num_leaves': [15, 31, 63],\n",
    "            'max_depth': [3, 5, 7, -1],\n",
    "            'min_child_samples': [1, 5, 10, 20],\n",
    "            'subsample': [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
    "            'colsample_bytree': [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
    "            'reg_alpha': [0, 0.01, 0.1, 1],\n",
    "            'reg_lambda': [0, 0.1, 1, 10],\n",
    "            'min_child_weight': [1e-5, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1],\n",
    "            'bagging_freq': [0, 1, 5],\n",
    "            'objective': ['regression'],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'n_jobs': [-1],\n",
    "            'verbose': [-1]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'GPBoost': (GPBoostRegressor, {\n",
    "            'n_estimators': [100, 200, 300, 400, 500],\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15],\n",
    "            'max_depth': [3, 5, 7, -1],\n",
    "            'num_leaves': [15, 31, 63],\n",
    "            'min_child_samples': [1, 5, 10, 20],\n",
    "            'subsample': [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
    "            'colsample_bytree': [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
    "            'reg_alpha': [0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0],\n",
    "            'reg_lambda': [0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0],\n",
    "            'min_child_weight': [1e-5, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'n_jobs': [-1],\n",
    "            'verbose': [-1]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'CatBoost': (CatBoostRegressor, {\n",
    "            'iterations': [200, 500, 1000],\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1],\n",
    "            'depth': [4, 6, 8, 10],\n",
    "            'l2_leaf_reg': [1, 3, 5, 7, 9],\n",
    "            'border_count': [32, 64, 128],\n",
    "            'min_data_in_leaf': [1, 5, 10, 20],\n",
    "            'rsm': [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],\n",
    "            'bagging_temperature': [0, 1, 10],\n",
    "            'random_seed': [42],\n",
    "            'verbose': [0]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'NGBoost': (NGBRegressor, {\n",
    "            'n_estimators': [200, 500, 1000],\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1],\n",
    "            'natural_gradient': [True, False],\n",
    "            'minibatch_frac': [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
    "            'col_sample': [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
    "            'Dist': [Normal],\n",
    "            'Score': [LogScore],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'verbose': [0]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'TabNet': (TabNetRegressor, {\n",
    "            'n_d': [8, 16, 32, 64],\n",
    "            'n_a': [8, 16, 32, 64],\n",
    "            'n_steps': [3, 5, 7, 10],\n",
    "            'gamma': [1.0, 1.3, 1.5, 2.0],\n",
    "            'lambda_sparse': [1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2],\n",
    "            'optimizer_params': [{'lr': 2e-2}], # Fixed learning rate as recommended\n",
    "            'mask_type': ['sparsemax', 'entmax'],\n",
    "            'n_shared': [1, 2, 3],\n",
    "            'n_independent': [1, 2, 3],\n",
    "            'scheduler_params': [{\"step_size\": 10, \"gamma\": 0.9}],\n",
    "            'scheduler_fn': [torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR],\n",
    "            'seed': [42],\n",
    "            'verbose': [0]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'HistGradientBoosting': (HistGradientBoostingRegressor, {\n",
    "            'learning_rate': [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15],\n",
    "            'max_iter': [100, 200, 300, 400, 500],\n",
    "            'max_depth': [3, 5, 7, None],\n",
    "            'min_samples_leaf': [5, 10, 20],\n",
    "            'max_leaf_nodes': [15, 31, 63, None],\n",
    "            'l2_regularization': [0.0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0],\n",
    "            'max_bins': [64, 128, 255],\n",
    "            'early_stopping': [True, False],\n",
    "            'validation_fraction': [0.1, 0.2],\n",
    "            'n_iter_no_change': [5, 10, 15],\n",
    "            'loss': ['squared_error'],\n",
    "            'random_state': [42],\n",
    "            'verbose': [0]\n",
    "        }),\n",
    "        'PGBM': (PGBM, {})\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    pruners = [\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.MedianPruner(),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.NopPruner(),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.PatientPruner(optuna.pruners.MedianPruner(), patience=3),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.PercentilePruner(25.0),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.SuccessiveHalvingPruner(),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.HyperbandPruner(),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.ThresholdPruner(lower=0.1),\n",
    "        optuna.pruners.WilcoxonPruner()\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "    best_scores = {}\n",
    "    predictions_df = pd.DataFrame({'Actual': y_test})\n",
    "    timing_records = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for model_name, (model_class, param_space) in models.items():\n",
    "\n",
    "        rmse_trial_history = {p.__class__.__name__: [] for p in pruners}\n",
    "\n",
    "        for pruner in pruners:\n",
    "            pruner_name = pruner.__class__.__name__\n",
    "            print(f\"Running Optuna for {model_name} with {pruner_name}...\")\n",
    "            start_time = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "            best_rmse_tracker[(model_name, pruner_name)] = np.inf\n",
    "\n",
    "            sampler = optunahub.load_module(\"samplers/auto_sampler\").AutoSampler()\n",
    "            study = optuna.create_study(direction='minimize', sampler=sampler, pruner=pruner)\n",
    "\n",
    "            if model_name == 'PGBM':\n",
    "\n",
    "                def pgbm_objective(trial):\n",
    "                    params = {\n",
    "                            'n_estimators': trial.suggest_categorical('n_estimators', [100, 200, 300, 500]),\n",
    "                            'learning_rate': trial.suggest_categorical('learning_rate', [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15]),\n",
    "                            'max_leaves': trial.suggest_int('max_leaves', 15, 63),\n",
    "                            'min_split_gain': trial.suggest_categorical('min_split_gain', [0.0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0]),\n",
    "                            'reg_lambda': trial.suggest_categorical('reg_lambda', [0.1, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0]),\n",
    "                            'feature_fraction': trial.suggest_categorical('feature_fraction', [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0]),\n",
    "                            'bagging_fraction': trial.suggest_categorical('bagging_fraction', [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0]),\n",
    "                            'tree_correlation': trial.suggest_categorical('tree_correlation', [0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3]),\n",
    "                            'min_data_in_leaf': trial.suggest_categorical('min_data_in_leaf', [3, 5, 10, 20]),\n",
    "                            'max_bin': trial.suggest_categorical('max_bin', [64, 128, 256]),\n",
    "                            'distribution': trial.suggest_categorical('distribution', ['normal', 'studentt', 'laplace']),\n",
    "                            'objective': 'mse',\n",
    "                            'metric': 'rmse',\n",
    "                            'random_state': 42,\n",
    "                            'verbose': 0\n",
    "                        }\n",
    "\n",
    "                    model = PGBM()\n",
    "                    model.train((X_train, y_train),\n",
    "                                objective=mseloss_objective,\n",
    "                                metric=rmseloss_metric,\n",
    "                                params=params)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "                    mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)\n",
    "                    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    rmse_trial_history[pruner_name].append(rmse)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    # ===== SAVE BEST MODEL =====\n",
    "                    if rmse < best_rmse_tracker[(model_name, pruner_name)]:\n",
    "                        best_rmse_tracker[(model_name, pruner_name)] = rmse\n",
    "                        save_path = os.path.join(\n",
    "                            model_save_dir,\n",
    "                            f\"{model_name}_{pruner_name}_BEST.pkl\"\n",
    "                        )\n",
    "                        _ensure_parent_dir(save_path)\n",
    "                        joblib.dump(model, _ensure_parent_dir(save_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "                    return mse\n",
    "\n",
    "                study.optimize(pgbm_objective, n_trials=50)\n",
    "\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "\n",
    "                def objective(trial):\n",
    "                    params = {}\n",
    "                    for key, values in param_space.items():\n",
    "                        params[key] = trial.suggest_categorical(key, values)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    model = model_class(**params)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    if model_name == 'TabNet':\n",
    "                        model.fit(X_train, y_train.reshape(-1, 1))\n",
    "                    else:\n",
    "                        model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "                    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    if model_name == 'TabNet':\n",
    "                        y_pred = y_pred.ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "                    mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    rmse_trial_history[pruner_name].append(rmse)\n",
    "\n",
    "                    # ===== SAVE BEST MODEL =====\n",
    "                    if rmse < best_rmse_tracker[(model_name, pruner_name)]:\n",
    "                        best_rmse_tracker[(model_name, pruner_name)] = rmse\n",
    "                        save_path = os.path.join(\n",
    "                            model_save_dir,\n",
    "                            f\"{model_name}_{pruner_name}_BEST.pkl\"\n",
    "                        )\n",
    "                        _ensure_parent_dir(save_path)\n",
    "                        joblib.dump(model, _ensure_parent_dir(save_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "                    return mse\n",
    "\n",
    "                study.optimize(objective, n_trials=50)\n",
    "\n",
    "            elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Load frozen model (NO RETRAIN)\n",
    "            best_model = joblib.load(\n",
    "                os.path.join(model_save_dir, f\"{model_name}_{pruner_name}_BEST.pkl\")\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            y_pred = best_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "            if model_name == 'TabNet':\n",
    "                y_pred = y_pred.ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "            mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)\n",
    "            rmse = np.sqrt(mse)\n",
    "            corr_coef = np.corrcoef(y_test, y_pred)[0, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "            predictions_df[f'{model_name}_{pruner_name}_Predicted'] = y_pred\n",
    "\n",
    "            best_scores[(model_name, pruner_name)] = {\n",
    "                'best_score': mse,\n",
    "                'best_params': study.best_params,\n",
    "                'test_mse': mse,\n",
    "                'test_rmse': rmse,\n",
    "                'test_corr_coef': corr_coef,\n",
    "                'pruner': pruner_name\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "            timing_records.append({\n",
    "                'Model': model_name,\n",
    "                'Pruner': pruner_name,\n",
    "                'Tuning_Time_Seconds': elapsed_time\n",
    "            })\n",
    "\n",
    "        # RMSE plots & Excel writing (UNCHANGED)\n",
    "        rmse_df = pd.DataFrame(rmse_trial_history)\n",
    "        rmse_df.insert(0, \"Trial\", np.arange(1, len(rmse_df) + 1))\n",
    "\n",
    "        if not os.path.exists(excel_path):\n",
    "            pd.DataFrame().to_excel(excel_path)\n",
    "        with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(excel_path)), engine='openpyxl', mode='a', if_sheet_exists='replace') as writer:\n",
    "            writer\n",
    "            rmse_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=f\"RMSE_Trials_{model_name}\", index=False)\n",
    "        # ================= SAVE RMSE PLOT =================\n",
    "        plot_dir = os.path.dirname(excel_path)\n",
    "        plot_path = os.path.join(plot_dir, f\"RMSE_Trials_{model_name}.png\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "        for pruner_name, values in rmse_trial_history.items():\n",
    "            if len(values) > 0:   # <-- important safety check\n",
    "                plt.plot(values, label=pruner_name, linewidth=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.title(f\"RMSE Variation Over Trials\\n{model_name}\")\n",
    "        plt.xlabel(\"Trial Number\")\n",
    "        plt.ylabel(\"RMSE\")\n",
    "        plt.legend(loc=\"center left\", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5))\n",
    "        plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "        _ensure_parent_dir(plot_path)\n",
    "        plt.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(plot_path), dpi=100, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "        plt.close()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ================= INSERT PLOT INTO EXCEL =================\n",
    "        wb = load_workbook(_ensure_excel_file(excel_path))\n",
    "        ws = wb[f\"RMSE_Trials_{model_name}\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "        img = Image(plot_path)\n",
    "        img.anchor = \"J2\"\n",
    "        ws.add_image(img)\n",
    "\n",
    "        _ensure_parent_dir(excel_path)\n",
    "        wb.save(_ensure_parent_dir(excel_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "    timing_df = pd.DataFrame(timing_records)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not os.path.exists(excel_path):\n",
    "        pd.DataFrame().to_excel(excel_path)\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(excel_path)), engine='openpyxl', mode='a') as writer:\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        predictions_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Predictions', index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        timing_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Tuning_Time', index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return best_scores\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "best_scores_autosampler = hyperparameter_tuning_all(X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, \"./drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/hyperparameter_tuning/test.xlsx\")\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def get_best_models_and_predict(best_scores_autosampler, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, file_path):\n",
    "    # Convert input data to NumPy arrays\n",
    "    X_train = np.array(X_train)\n",
    "    y_train = np.array(y_train)\n",
    "    X_test = np.array(X_test)\n",
    "    y_test = np.array(y_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Mapping for model creation based on dictionary keys\n",
    "    model_mapping = {\n",
    "        'Random Forest': RandomForestRegressor,\n",
    "        'Gradient Boosting': GradientBoostingRegressor,\n",
    "        'XGBoost': XGBRegressor,\n",
    "        'LightGBM': LGBMRegressor,\n",
    "        'CatBoost': CatBoostRegressor,\n",
    "        'GPBoost': GPBoostRegressor,\n",
    "        'NGBoost': NGBRegressor,\n",
    "        'TabNet': TabNetRegressor,\n",
    "        'HistGradientBoosting': HistGradientBoostingRegressor,\n",
    "        'PGBM': PGBM  # PGBM is handled separately\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Dictionary to store the best model for each type\n",
    "    best_models = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Iterate over the dictionary to find the best pruner for each model type\n",
    "    for (model_name, pruner), params in best_scores_autosampler.items():\n",
    "        current_score = params.get('test_mse', np.inf)\n",
    "        if model_name not in best_models or current_score < best_models[model_name]['score']:\n",
    "            best_models[model_name] = {\n",
    "                'score': current_score,\n",
    "                'params': params['best_params'],\n",
    "                'pruner': pruner\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Prepare a DataFrame to store predictions\n",
    "    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Iterate over the best models to train and predict\n",
    "    for model_name, model_info in best_models.items():\n",
    "        best_params = model_info['params']\n",
    "        model_class = model_mapping.get(model_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if model_class is None:\n",
    "            print(f\"Model {model_name} is not supported or not available.\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Handle specific parameters or settings for model if needed\n",
    "        if model_name == 'CatBoost':\n",
    "            best_params.pop('verbose', None)  # Remove 'verbose' for CatBoost\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Create an instance of the best model with the best parameters\n",
    "        if model_name == 'PGBM':\n",
    "            model = model_class()\n",
    "            model.train((X_train, y_train), objective=mseloss_objective, metric=rmseloss_metric, params=best_params)\n",
    "            predictions = model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "        elif model_name == 'TabNet':\n",
    "            model = model_class(**best_params)\n",
    "            model.fit(X_train, y_train.reshape(-1, 1))\n",
    "            predictions = model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "            predictions = predictions.ravel()\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            model = model_class(**best_params)\n",
    "            model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "            predictions = model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Add predictions to the DataFrame\n",
    "        df[f'{model_name} Predictions'] = predictions\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Plot actual vs. predicted\n",
    "        plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "        plt.scatter(y_test, predictions, alpha=0.6)\n",
    "        plt.plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()], [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], 'k--', color='red', lw=2)\n",
    "        plt.xlabel(\"Actual str\")\n",
    "        plt.ylabel(\"Predicted str\")\n",
    "        plt.title(f\"Actual vs. Predicted Values ({model_name})\")\n",
    "        plt.grid(True)\n",
    "        plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Save the plot temporarily\n",
    "        plot_path = f'temp_plot_{model_name}.png'\n",
    "        _ensure_parent_dir(plot_path)\n",
    "        plt.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(plot_path))\n",
    "        plt.close()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # \u2705 NEW OUTPUT DIRECTORY\n",
    "    output_dir = \"./drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/hyperparameter_tuning/\"\n",
    "    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    output_excel_path = os.path.join(\n",
    "        output_dir,\n",
    "        os.path.basename(file_path).replace('.csv', '_results.xlsx')\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save predictions and plots to Excel\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(output_excel_path), engine='xlsxwriter') as writer:\n",
    "        # Write data to Excel\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='data', index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Get the xlsxwriter objects\n",
    "        workbook = writer.book\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Insert each plot into a separate worksheet\n",
    "        for model_name in best_models.keys():\n",
    "            short_model_name = ''.join([word[0] for word in model_name.split()])\n",
    "            sheet_name = f'{short_model_name}_Plot'\n",
    "\n",
    "            worksheet = workbook.add_worksheet(sheet_name)\n",
    "            writer.sheets[sheet_name] = worksheet\n",
    "            plot_path = f'temp_plot_{model_name}.png'\n",
    "            worksheet.insert_image('A1', plot_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Clean up temporary plot files\n",
    "    for model_name in best_models.keys():\n",
    "        if os.path.exists(str(f'temp_plot_{model_name}.png')): os.remove(str(f'temp_plot_{model_name}.png'))\n",
    "\n",
    "    return df, best_models\n",
    "\n",
    "# Call the function\n",
    "df, best_models = get_best_models_and_predict(best_scores_autosampler, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, \"./drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/data/test.csv\")"
   ]
  },

    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def set_seed(seed=42):\n",
    "    random.seed(seed)\n",
    "    np.random.seed(seed)\n",
    "    torch.manual_seed(seed)\n",
    "    if torch.cuda.is_available():\n",
    "        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def build_demo_dataframe(n_rows, feature_names, seed=42, is_train=True):\n",
    "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + (0 if is_train else 99))\n",
    "    data = {name: rng.normal(loc=0.0, scale=1.0, size=n_rows) for name in feature_names}\n",
    "    frame = pd.DataFrame(data)\n",
    "    nonlinear_term = 0.8 * np.sin(frame[feature_names[0]].values)\n",
    "    interaction_term = 0.5 * frame[feature_names[1]].values * frame[feature_names[2]].values\n",
    "    trend_term = 0.3 * frame[feature_names[0]].values ** 2\n",
    "    noise = rng.normal(loc=0.0, scale=0.35 if is_train else 0.4, size=n_rows)\n",
    "    frame['Target'] = 12.0 + 3.2 * frame[feature_names[0]].values - 1.7 * frame[feature_names[1]].values + 2.1 * frame[feature_names[2]].values + nonlinear_term + interaction_term - trend_term + noise\n",
    "    return frame\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def read_csv_from_candidates(path_candidates):\n",
    "    for path in path_candidates:\n",
    "        path = Path(path)\n",
    "        if not path.exists():\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            df = pd.read_csv(path)\n",
    "            if not df.empty:\n",
    "                print(f\"Loaded data from: {path}\")\n",
    "                return df\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame()\n",
    "random_seed = 42\n",
    "\n",
    "set_seed(random_seed)\n",
    "train_demo = build_demo_dataframe(240, feature_names, seed=random_seed, is_train=True)\n",
    "test_demo = build_demo_dataframe(80, feature_names, seed=random_seed, is_train=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "train_candidates = [\n",
    "    train_data_path,\n",
    "    \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/data/train.csv\",\n",
    "    \"concrete_uncertainty_analysis/data/train.csv\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "test_candidates = [\n",
    "    test_data_path,\n",
    "    \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/data/test.csv\",\n",
    "    \"concrete_uncertainty_analysis/data/test.csv\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "train_data = read_csv_from_candidates(train_candidates)\n",
    "test_data = read_csv_from_candidates(test_candidates)\n",
    "\n",
    "if train_data.empty:\n",
    "    print(\"Warning: training CSV is missing or empty. A generated demo Dataset will be used so the notebook can still run in Google Colab.\")\n",
    "    train_data = train_demo.copy()\n",
    "if test_data.empty:\n",
    "    print(\"Warning: testing CSV is missing or empty. A generated demo Dataset will be used so the notebook can still run in Google Colab.\")\n",
    "    test_data = test_demo.copy()\n"
   ],

  },

   "source": [
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_excel_file(path):\n",
    "    import os\n",
    "    import pandas as pd\n",
    "    if not os.path.exists(path):\n",
    "        parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "        if parent:\n",
    "            os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "        pd.DataFrame().to_excel(path)\n",
    "    return path"
   ],
   "id": "GF2SpK0wYccX"
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {
    "id": "P6PyEXeqYccX",
    "executionInfo": {
     "status": "ok",
     "timestamp": 1778246096970,
     "user_tz": -330,
     "elapsed": 177,
     "user": {
      "displayName": "Gemini CLI",
      "userId": "13300916092578453215"
     }
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def expand_scalar_targets(y_array):\n",
    "    y_array = np.asarray(y_array, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1, 1)\n",
    "    return np.concatenate([y_array, y_array], axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def create_dataloader(X_array, y_array, batch_size=64, shuffle=True):\n",
    "    features = torch.tensor(X_array, dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "    expanded_targets = torch.tensor(expand_scalar_targets(y_array), dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "    Dataset = TensorDataset(features, expanded_targets)\n",
    "    return DataLoader(Dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=shuffle)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "class HCMUCIRegressor(nn.Module):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Paper-style tabular regression backbone: 3 hidden layers of width 20 with LeakyReLU.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    def __init__(self, input_dim):\n",
    "        super().__init__()\n",
    "        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, 20)\n",
    "        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(20, 20)\n",
    "        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(20, 20)\n",
    "        self.fc4 = nn.Linear(20, 2)   # direction d\n",
    "        self.fc5 = nn.Linear(20, 1)   # magnitude R\n",
    "        self.act = nn.LeakyReLU(0.01)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def forward(self, x):\n",
    "        x = self.act(self.fc1(x))\n",
    "        x = self.act(self.fc2(x))\n",
    "        x = self.act(self.fc3(x))\n",
    "        d = self.fc4(x)\n",
    "        R = self.fc5(x)\n",
    "        return R, d\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def train_hcm_model(X_train, y_train, X_val, y_val, training_config):\n",
    "    set_seed(training_config['seed'])\n",
    "    device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')\n",
    "    model = HCMUCIRegressor(X_train.shape[1]).to(device)\n",
    "    criterion = nn.MSELoss()\n",
    "    optimizer = optim.Adam(\n",
    "        model.parameters(),\n",
    "        lr=training_config['learning_rate'],\n",
    "        weight_decay=training_config['weight_decay']\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    train_loader = create_dataloader(X_train, y_train, batch_size=training_config['batch_size'], shuffle=True)\n",
    "    history = []\n",
    "    best_state = None\n",
    "    best_val_loss = np.inf\n",
    "    patience_counter = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_val_expanded = expand_scalar_targets(y_val)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for epoch in range(training_config['epochs']):\n",
    "        model.train()\n",
    "        epoch_loss = []\n",
    "        epoch_r_loss = []\n",
    "        epoch_d_loss = []\n",
    "\n",
    "        for x_batch, y_expanded in train_loader:\n",
    "            x_batch = x_batch.to(device)\n",
    "            y_expanded = y_expanded.to(device)\n",
    "\n",
    "            optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
    "            pred_R, pred_d = model(x_batch)\n",
    "\n",
    "            R_target = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(y_expanded ** 2, dim=1, keepdim=True))\n",
    "            d_target = y_expanded / (R_target + 1e-8)\n",
    "\n",
    "            d_loss = criterion(pred_R * d_target, y_expanded)\n",
    "            R_loss = criterion(R_target * pred_d, y_expanded)\n",
    "            loss = d_loss + R_loss\n",
    "\n",
    "            loss.backward()\n",
    "            optimizer.step()\n",
    "\n",
    "            epoch_loss.append(loss.item())\n",
    "            epoch_r_loss.append(R_loss.item())\n",
    "            epoch_d_loss.append(d_loss.item())\n",
    "\n",
    "        val_outputs = predict_hcm_outputs(model, X_val, device)\n",
    "        val_loss = mean_squared_error(y_val.reshape(-1), val_outputs['mean_prediction'])\n",
    "        history.append({\n",
    "            'epoch': epoch + 1,\n",
    "            'train_loss': float(np.mean(epoch_loss)),\n",
    "            'R_loss': float(np.mean(epoch_r_loss)),\n",
    "            'd_loss': float(np.mean(epoch_d_loss)),\n",
    "            'val_mse': float(val_loss)\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "        if val_loss < best_val_loss:\n",
    "            best_val_loss = val_loss\n",
    "            best_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}\n",
    "            patience_counter = 0\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            patience_counter += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "        if (epoch + 1) % training_config['print_every'] == 0 or epoch == 0:\n",
    "            print(f\"Epoch {epoch + 1}/{training_config['epochs']} | Loss: {np.mean(epoch_loss):.5f} | R Loss: {np.mean(epoch_r_loss):.5f} | d Loss: {np.mean(epoch_d_loss):.5f} | Val MSE: {val_loss:.5f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        if patience_counter >= training_config['patience']:\n",
    "            print(f\"Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch + 1}\")\n",
    "            break\n",
    "\n",
    "    if best_state is not None:\n",
    "        model.load_state_dict(best_state)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return model, pd.DataFrame(history), device\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "@torch.no_grad()\n",
    "def predict_hcm_outputs(model, X_array, device):\n",
    "    model.eval()\n",
    "    model.to(device)\n",
    "\n",
    "    x_tensor = torch.tensor(X_array, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)\n",
    "    pred_R, pred_d = model(x_tensor)\n",
    "\n",
    "    d_norm_sq = torch.sum(pred_d ** 2, dim=1)\n",
    "    d_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(d_norm_sq, min=1e-12))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Public GitHub regression example uses this as the uncertainty band width.\n",
    "    sigma_hat = torch.sqrt(torch.abs(d_norm_sq - 1.0)) * torch.abs(pred_R.squeeze(-1))\n",
    "    raw_u = torch.abs(pred_R.squeeze(-1)) * torch.abs(d_norm - 1.0)\n",
    "    pred_y = (pred_R * pred_d)[:, 0]\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        'mean_prediction': pred_y.cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "        'pred_R': pred_R.squeeze(-1).cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "        'pred_d': pred_d.cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "        'd_norm_sq': d_norm_sq.cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "        'd_norm': d_norm.cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "        'sigma_hat_raw': sigma_hat.cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "        'raw_uncertainty_score': raw_u.cpu().numpy(),\n",
    "    }\n"
   ],
   "id": "P6PyEXeqYccX"
  },

    "def search_temperature_scale(raw_sigma, absolute_errors, grid=None):\n",
    "    raw_sigma = np.clip(np.asarray(raw_sigma, dtype=float), 1e-8, None)\n",
    "    absolute_errors = np.asarray(absolute_errors, dtype=float)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if grid is None:\n",
    "        grid = np.logspace(-2, 2, 400)\n",
    "\n",
    "    target_coverage = np.array([0.68, 0.95, 0.997])\n",
    "    best_scale = 1.0\n",
    "    best_loss = np.inf\n",
    "\n",
    "    for scale in grid:\n",
    "        sigma_scaled = raw_sigma * scale\n",
    "        coverage = np.array([\n",
    "            np.mean(absolute_errors <= sigma_scaled),\n",
    "            np.mean(absolute_errors <= 2.0 * sigma_scaled),\n",
    "            np.mean(absolute_errors <= 3.0 * sigma_scaled)\n",
    "        ])\n",
    "        loss = np.sum((coverage - target_coverage) ** 2)\n",
    "        if loss < best_loss:\n",
    "            best_loss = loss\n",
    "            best_scale = scale\n",
    "\n",
    "    return float(best_scale)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def normalize_confidence(confidence_values):\n",
    "    confidence_values = np.asarray(confidence_values, dtype=float)\n",
    "    cmin, cmax = confidence_values.min(), confidence_values.max()\n",
    "    if np.isclose(cmin, cmax):\n",
    "        return np.ones_like(confidence_values)\n",
    "    return (confidence_values - cmin) / (cmax - cmin)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def create_predictions_dataframe(output_dict, y_true, sigma_scale, target_scaler):\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).reshape(-1)\n",
    "    mean_prediction_scaled = np.asarray(output_dict['mean_prediction'], dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)\n",
    "    mean_prediction = target_scaler.inverse_transform(mean_prediction_scaled).reshape(-1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sigma_raw_scaled = np.clip(np.asarray(output_dict['sigma_hat_raw'], dtype=float), 1e-8, None)\n",
    "    sigma_calibrated_scaled = sigma_raw_scaled * sigma_scale\n",
    "    sigma_raw = sigma_raw_scaled * float(target_scaler.scale_[0])\n",
    "    sigma_calibrated = sigma_calibrated_scaled * float(target_scaler.scale_[0])\n",
    "    raw_uncertainty = np.asarray(output_dict['raw_uncertainty_score'], dtype=float) * float(target_scaler.scale_[0])\n",
    "    absolute_error = np.abs(y_true - mean_prediction)\n",
    "\n",
    "    confidence = np.exp(-sigma_calibrated_scaled)\n",
    "    confidence_normalized = normalize_confidence(confidence)\n",
    "\n",
    "    predictions_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Mean': mean_prediction,\n",
    "        'Mean_Scaled': mean_prediction_scaled.reshape(-1),\n",
    "        'Sigma_Hat_Raw': sigma_raw,\n",
    "        'Sigma_Hat_Raw_Scaled': sigma_raw_scaled,\n",
    "        'Sigma_Hat': sigma_calibrated,\n",
    "        'Sigma_Hat_Scaled': sigma_calibrated_scaled,\n",
    "        'StdDev': sigma_calibrated,\n",
    "        'Confidence': confidence,\n",
    "        'Confidence_Normalized': confidence_normalized,\n",
    "        'RawUncertainty': raw_uncertainty,\n",
    "        'Magnitude_R': output_dict['pred_R'],\n",
    "        'Direction_Norm': output_dict['d_norm'],\n",
    "        'Direction_Norm_Squared': output_dict['d_norm_sq'],\n",
    "        'Absolute_Error': absolute_error,\n",
    "        'Actual': y_true\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    for k in [1, 2, 3]:\n",
    "        predictions_df[f'Lower_{k}Sigma'] = predictions_df['Mean'] - k * predictions_df['Sigma_Hat']\n",
    "        predictions_df[f'Upper_{k}Sigma'] = predictions_df['Mean'] + k * predictions_df['Sigma_Hat']\n",
    "        predictions_df[f'Coverage_{k}Sigma'] = (\n",
    "            (predictions_df['Actual'] >= predictions_df[f'Lower_{k}Sigma']) &\n",
    "            (predictions_df['Actual'] <= predictions_df[f'Upper_{k}Sigma'])\n",
    "        ).astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "    z_95 = 1.96\n",
    "    predictions_df['Lower_95'] = predictions_df['Mean'] - z_95 * predictions_df['Sigma_Hat']\n",
    "    predictions_df['Upper_95'] = predictions_df['Mean'] + z_95 * predictions_df['Sigma_Hat']\n",
    "    predictions_df['Coverage_95'] = (\n",
    "        (predictions_df['Actual'] >= predictions_df['Lower_95']) &\n",
    "        (predictions_df['Actual'] <= predictions_df['Upper_95'])\n",
    "    ).astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return predictions_df\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def compute_regression_ece(sigma_values, absolute_errors, n_bins=10):\n",
    "    sigma_values = np.asarray(sigma_values, dtype=float)\n",
    "    absolute_errors = np.asarray(absolute_errors, dtype=float)\n",
    "    quantile_edges = np.quantile(sigma_values, np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1))\n",
    "    quantile_edges[0] -= 1e-8\n",
    "    quantile_edges[-1] += 1e-8\n",
    "\n",
    "    total = len(sigma_values)\n",
    "    ece = 0.0\n",
    "    rows = []\n",
    "    for idx in range(n_bins):\n",
    "        lower = quantile_edges[idx]\n",
    "        upper = quantile_edges[idx + 1]\n",
    "        mask = (sigma_values >= lower) & (sigma_values < upper)\n",
    "        if not np.any(mask):\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        mean_sigma = sigma_values[mask].mean()\n",
    "        mean_error = absolute_errors[mask].mean()\n",
    "        weight = mask.sum() / total\n",
    "        ece += weight * abs(mean_sigma - mean_error)\n",
    "        rows.append({\n",
    "            'Bin': idx + 1,\n",
    "            'Bin_Size': int(mask.sum()),\n",
    "            'Mean_Sigma': mean_sigma,\n",
    "            'Mean_Absolute_Error': mean_error,\n",
    "            'Absolute_Gap': abs(mean_sigma - mean_error)\n",
    "        })\n",
    "    return float(ece), pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def compute_paper_metrics(predictions_df, model_name='HCM'):\n",
    "    absolute_error = predictions_df['Absolute_Error'].values\n",
    "    sigma = np.clip(predictions_df['Sigma_Hat'].values, 1e-8, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "    coverage_1 = np.mean(absolute_error <= sigma)\n",
    "    coverage_2 = np.mean(absolute_error <= 2.0 * sigma)\n",
    "    coverage_3 = np.mean(absolute_error <= 3.0 * sigma)\n",
    "    coverage_95 = predictions_df['Coverage_95'].mean()\n",
    "    average_95_width = (predictions_df['Upper_95'] - predictions_df['Lower_95']).mean()\n",
    "    ece_reg, ece_bins_df = compute_regression_ece(sigma, absolute_error, n_bins=10)\n",
    "\n",
    "    pearson_value = pearsonr(sigma, absolute_error)[0]\n",
    "    spearman_value = spearmanr(sigma, absolute_error)[0]\n",
    "    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(predictions_df['Actual'], predictions_df['Mean']))\n",
    "    mae = mean_absolute_error(predictions_df['Actual'], predictions_df['Mean'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        'Model': model_name,\n",
    "        'Cov@1Sigma': coverage_1,\n",
    "        'Cov@2Sigma': coverage_2,\n",
    "        'Cov@3Sigma': coverage_3,\n",
    "        'Coverage_95Interval': coverage_95,\n",
    "        'Average_95Interval_Width': average_95_width,\n",
    "        'Pearson': pearson_value,\n",
    "        'Spearman': spearman_value,\n",
    "        'ECE_reg': ece_reg,\n",
    "        'RMSE': rmse,\n",
    "        'MAE': mae\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "    return summary_df, ece_bins_df\n"
   ],
   "id": "1oKT0rifYccY"
  },

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_paper_metrics(predictions_df, excel_path, model_name='HCM'):\n",
    "    paper_metrics_df, ece_bins_df = compute_paper_metrics(predictions_df, model_name=model_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "    coverage_df = pd.DataFrame([\n",
    "        {'Scale': '1Sigma', 'Coverage': predictions_df['Coverage_1Sigma'].mean(), 'Target': 0.68},\n",
    "        {'Scale': '95PercentInterval', 'Coverage': predictions_df['Coverage_95'].mean(), 'Target': 0.95},\n",
    "        {'Scale': '2Sigma', 'Coverage': predictions_df['Coverage_2Sigma'].mean(), 'Target': 0.95},\n",
    "        {'Scale': '3Sigma', 'Coverage': predictions_df['Coverage_3Sigma'].mean(), 'Target': 0.997},\n",
    "    ])\n",
    "\n",
    "    confidence_bins = pd.qcut(predictions_df['Confidence_Normalized'], q=min(10, len(predictions_df)), duplicates='drop')\n",
    "    confidence_bin_df = predictions_df.assign(Confidence_Bin=confidence_bins).groupby('Confidence_Bin', observed=False).agg(\n",
    "        Mean_Confidence=('Confidence_Normalized', 'mean'),\n",
    "        Mean_Absolute_Error=('Absolute_Error', 'mean'),\n",
    "        Mean_Sigma=('Sigma_Hat', 'mean'),\n",
    "        Count=('Confidence_Normalized', 'size')\n",
    "    ).reset_index()\n",
    "\n",
    "    percentile_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Percentile': [50, 75, 90, 95, 99],\n",
    "        'Sigma_Hat_Threshold': np.percentile(predictions_df['Sigma_Hat'], [50, 75, 90, 95, 99]),\n",
    "        'RawUncertainty_Threshold': np.percentile(predictions_df['RawUncertainty'], [50, 75, 90, 95, 99])\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not os.path.exists(excel_path):\n",
    "        pd.DataFrame().to_excel(excel_path)\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(excel_path)), engine='openpyxl', mode='a', if_sheet_exists='replace') as writer:\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        paper_metrics_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Paper_Metrics', index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        coverage_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Coverage_Details', index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        ece_bins_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='ECE_Bins', index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        confidence_bin_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Confidence_Bins', index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        percentile_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Uncertainty_Thresholds', index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_and_save_secondary_metrics(predictions_df, excel_path, model_name='HCM'):\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = np.clip(predictions_df['Sigma_Hat'].values, 1e-8, None)\n",
    "    y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    crps_values = ps.crps_gaussian(y_true, mu=mu_pred, sig=sigma_pred)\n",
    "    nll_values = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi * sigma_pred**2) - ((y_true - mu_pred) ** 2) / (2 * sigma_pred**2)\n",
    "    secondary_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Mean': mu_pred,\n",
    "        'Sigma_Hat': sigma_pred,\n",
    "        'CRPS': crps_values,\n",
    "        'LogLikelihood': nll_values\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        'Model': model_name,\n",
    "        'Mean_CRPS': float(np.mean(crps_values)),\n",
    "        'Mean_Negative_LogLikelihood': float(np.mean(-nll_values)),\n",
    "        'Coverage_95Interval': float(predictions_df['Coverage_95'].mean())\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not os.path.exists(excel_path):\n",
    "        pd.DataFrame().to_excel(excel_path)\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(excel_path)), engine='openpyxl', mode='a', if_sheet_exists='replace') as writer:\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        secondary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Secondary_Compatibility', index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Secondary_Summary', index=False)\n"
   ],
   "id": "SD1hNHzsYccb"
  },

    "def build_matrix_evaluation(predictions_df, model_name='HCM'):\n",
    "    paper_metrics_df, _ = compute_paper_metrics(predictions_df, model_name=model_name)\n",
    "    matrix_df = paper_metrics_df.copy()\n",
    "    matrix_df['Mean_Sigma_Hat'] = predictions_df['Sigma_Hat'].mean()\n",
    "    matrix_df['Mean_RawUncertainty'] = predictions_df['RawUncertainty'].mean()\n",
    "    matrix_df['Coverage_95Interval'] = predictions_df['Coverage_95'].mean()\n",
    "    matrix_df['Average_95Interval_Width'] = (predictions_df['Upper_95'] - predictions_df['Lower_95']).mean()\n",
    "    return matrix_df\n"
   ],

    "# Train model\n",
    "model, training_history_df, device = train_hcm_model(\n",
    "    X_train,\n",
    "    y_train,\n",
    "    X_val,\n",
    "    y_val,\n",
    "    training_config\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Validation outputs\n",
    "validation_outputs = predict_hcm_outputs(\n",
    "    model,\n",
    "    X_val,\n",
    "    device\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Temperature scaling\n",
    "validation_scale = search_temperature_scale(\n",
    "    validation_outputs['sigma_hat_raw'],\n",
    "    np.abs(\n",
    "        y_val.reshape(-1)\n",
    "        - validation_outputs['mean_prediction']\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Validation temperature scale: {validation_scale:.6f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Test prediction\n",
    "test_outputs = predict_hcm_outputs(\n",
    "    model,\n",
    "    X_test_scaled,\n",
    "    device\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build prediction dataframe\n",
    "predictions_HCM_df = create_predictions_dataframe(\n",
    "    test_outputs,\n",
    "    y_test_array,\n",
    "    validation_scale,\n",
    "    target_scaler\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_HCM_df.head())"

    "def get_best_model_params(results, model_name):\n",
    "    # Map model names to dictionary keys, assuming keys are strings like 'XGBoost' and not objects\n",
    "    model_keys = {\n",
    "        'LightGBM': 'LightGBM',\n",
    "        'XGBoost': 'XGBoost',\n",
    "        'GPBoost': 'GPBoost',\n",
    "        'NGBoost': 'NGBoost',\n",
    "        'GradientBoosting': 'Gradient Boosting',\n",
    "        'HGBR' : 'HistGradientBoosting',\n",
    "        'CatBoost' : 'CatBoost',\n",
    "        'PGBM' : 'PGBM'\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure the requested model name is valid\n",
    "    if model_name not in model_keys:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"Model name '{model_name}' is not recognized. Available models are: {list(model_keys.keys())}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Filter out entries for the specified model\n",
    "    model_entries = {key: value for key, value in results.items() if key[0] == model_keys[model_name]}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Find the entry with the best (lowest) 'best_score'\n",
    "    best_entry_key, best_entry_value = min(model_entries.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]['best_score'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Return the best hyperparameters\n",
    "    return best_entry_value['best_params']"
   ]
  },

    "\n",

    "    plt.plot(range(len(predictions_df)), predictions_df['Mean'], color='black', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)\n",
    "    plt.title('Predicted Mean with Uncertainty Bands', fontsize=16)\n",

    "\n",
    "    # 3. Histogram of Standard Deviations\n",

   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_crps_decomposition(\n",
    "    predictions_df,\n",
    "    y_true,\n",
    "    excel_path,\n",
    "    model_name=\"Model\",\n",
    "    n_bins=10\n",
    "):\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Input handling\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = predictions_df['StdDev'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    if 'Actual' in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Total CRPS\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    crps_values = ps.crps_gaussian(\n",
    "        y_true, mu=mu_pred, sig=sigma_pred\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    total_crps = np.mean(crps_values)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Uncertainty (climatology)\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    global_mu = np.mean(y_true)\n",
    "    global_sigma = np.std(y_true)\n",
    "\n",
    "    uncertainty = np.mean(\n",
    "        ps.crps_gaussian(y_true, mu=global_mu, sig=global_sigma)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Reliability & Resolution\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    sort_idx = np.argsort(mu_pred)\n",
    "    y_sorted = y_true[sort_idx]\n",
    "    mu_sorted = mu_pred[sort_idx]\n",
    "    sigma_sorted = sigma_pred[sort_idx]\n",
    "\n",
    "    bins = np.array_split(np.arange(len(y_true)), n_bins)\n",
    "\n",
    "    bin_results = []\n",
    "    reliability_sum = 0.0\n",
    "\n",
    "    for i, b in enumerate(bins):\n",
    "        bin_y = y_sorted[b]\n",
    "        bin_mu = mu_sorted[b]\n",
    "        bin_sigma = sigma_sorted[b]\n",
    "\n",
    "        bin_crps = np.mean(\n",
    "            ps.crps_gaussian(bin_y, mu=bin_mu, sig=bin_sigma)\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        reliability_sum += bin_crps\n",
    "\n",
    "        bin_results.append({\n",
    "            \"Bin\": i + 1,\n",
    "            \"Bin_Size\": len(b),\n",
    "            \"Mean_Pred_Mu\": np.mean(bin_mu),\n",
    "            \"Mean_Pred_Sigma\": np.mean(bin_sigma),\n",
    "            \"Bin_CRPS\": bin_crps\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "    reliability = reliability_sum / n_bins\n",
    "    resolution = uncertainty - (total_crps - reliability)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Summary table\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"Total_CRPS\": total_crps,\n",
    "        \"Reliability\": reliability,\n",
    "        \"Resolution\": resolution,\n",
    "        \"Uncertainty\": uncertainty,\n",
    "        \"Num_Bins\": n_bins\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    bin_df = pd.DataFrame(bin_results)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Save to Excel\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    excel_path = Path(excel_path)\n",
    "    excel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sheet_summary = f\"CRPS_Summary_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_bins = f\"CRPS_Bins_{model_name}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(\n",
    "        excel_path)),\n",
    "        engine=\"openpyxl\",\n",
    "        mode=\"a\" if excel_path.exists() else \"w\",\n",
    "        if_sheet_exists=\"replace\"\n",
    "    ) as writer:\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_summary, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        bin_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_bins, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"✅ CRPS decomposition saved to:\\n{excel_path}\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   Sheets: {sheet_summary}, {sheet_bins}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return summary_df"
   ]
  },
  {

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_pit_results(\n",
    "    predictions_df,\n",
    "    y_true,\n",
    "    excel_path,\n",
    "    model_name=\"Model\",\n",
    "    n_bins=10\n",
    "):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Generate PIT values, histogram, calibration diagnostics,\n",
    "    and save everything to Excel with the PIT plot EMBEDDED.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Input handling\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = predictions_df['StdDev'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    if 'Actual' in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    sigma_pred = np.clip(sigma_pred, 1e-6, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Compute PIT values\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    pit_values = norm.cdf(y_true, loc=mu_pred, scale=sigma_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "    pit_df = pd.DataFrame({\"PIT_Value\": pit_values})\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Histogram data\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    hist_density, bin_edges = np.histogram(\n",
    "        pit_values, bins=n_bins, range=(0, 1), density=True\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    bin_centers = 0.5 * (bin_edges[:-1] + bin_edges[1:])\n",
    "\n",
    "    hist_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        \"Bin_Center\": bin_centers,\n",
    "        \"Density\": hist_density\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Calibration diagnostics\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    pit_mean = pit_values.mean()\n",
    "    pit_var = pit_values.var()\n",
    "    ks_stat, ks_pvalue = kstest(pit_values, 'uniform')\n",
    "\n",
    "    if ks_pvalue > 0.05:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Well-calibrated (Uniform PIT)\"\n",
    "    elif pit_var < 1/12:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Over-dispersed (Under-confident)\"\n",
    "    elif pit_var > 1/12:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Under-dispersed (Over-confident)\"\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Biased or miscalibrated\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"Mean_PIT\": pit_mean,\n",
    "        \"Variance_PIT\": pit_var,\n",
    "        \"Ideal_Variance_(1/12)\": 1/12,\n",
    "        \"KS_Statistic\": ks_stat,\n",
    "        \"KS_pvalue\": ks_pvalue,\n",
    "        \"Calibration_Diagnosis\": diagnosis\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Create PIT plot in memory\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
    "    ax.hist(\n",
    "        pit_values,\n",
    "        bins=n_bins,\n",
    "        density=True,\n",
    "        color=\"skyblue\",\n",
    "        edgecolor=\"black\",\n",
    "        alpha=0.75\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    ax.axhline(1, color=\"red\", linestyle=\"--\", label=\"Perfect Calibration\")\n",
    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"PIT Value\")\n",
    "    ax.set_ylabel(\"Density\")\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"PIT Histogram – {model_name}\")\n",
    "    ax.legend()\n",
    "    fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    img_buffer = BytesIO()\n",
    "    fig.savefig(img_buffer, format=\"png\", dpi=300)\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    img_buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Save to Excel\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    excel_path = Path(excel_path)\n",
    "    excel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sheet_values = f\"PIT_Values_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_hist = f\"PIT_Histogram_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_summary = f\"PIT_Summary_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_plot = f\"PIT_Plot_{model_name}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(\n",
    "        excel_path)),\n",
    "        engine=\"openpyxl\",\n",
    "        mode=\"a\" if excel_path.exists() else \"w\",\n",
    "        if_sheet_exists=\"replace\"\n",
    "    ) as writer:\n",
    "\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        pit_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_values, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        hist_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_hist, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_summary, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Create empty sheet for plot\n",
    "        workbook = writer.book\n",
    "        worksheet = workbook.create_sheet(sheet_plot)\n",
    "\n",
    "        img = openpyxlImage(img_buffer)\n",
    "        img.width = img.width * 0.4\n",
    "        img.height = img.height * 0.4\n",
    "\n",
    "        img.anchor = \"B2\"\n",
    "        worksheet.add_image(img)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"✅ PIT values, histogram, summary, and EMBEDDED plot saved to:\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {excel_path}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pit_df"
   ]
