    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_calibration_curve(\n",
    "    predictions_df,\n",
    "    y_true,\n",
    "    excel_path,\n",
    "    model_name=\"Model\",\n",
    "    n_quantiles=10\n",
    "):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Generate quantile calibration curve (reliability diagram),\n",
    "    compute calibration errors, and save everything to Excel\n",
    "    with the plot EMBEDDED.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Input handling\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = predictions_df['StdDev'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    if 'Actual' in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "    sigma_pred = np.clip(sigma_pred, 1e-6, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Quantiles\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    quantiles = np.linspace(0, 1, n_quantiles + 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    observed_freq = []\n",
    "    predicted_q = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for q in quantiles:\n",
    "        # Predicted value at quantile q\n",
    "        thresh = norm.ppf(q, loc=mu_pred, scale=sigma_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Observed frequency\n",
    "        obs = np.mean(y_true <= thresh)\n",
    "\n",
    "        predicted_q.append(q)\n",
    "        observed_freq.append(obs)\n",
    "\n",
    "    predicted_q = np.array(predicted_q)\n",
    "    observed_freq = np.array(observed_freq)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Calibration metrics\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mce = np.mean(np.abs(observed_freq - predicted_q))\n",
    "    rmsce = np.sqrt(np.mean((observed_freq - predicted_q) ** 2))\n",
    "\n",
    "    calib_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        \"Predicted_Quantile\": predicted_q,\n",
    "        \"Observed_Frequency\": observed_freq,\n",
    "        \"Absolute_Error\": np.abs(observed_freq - predicted_q)\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"Mean_Calibration_Error (MCE)\": mce,\n",
    "        \"RMS_Calibration_Error (RMSCE)\": rmsce,\n",
    "        \"Num_Quantiles\": n_quantiles\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Create calibration plot\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', label=\"Perfect Calibration\")\n",
    "    ax.plot(\n",
    "        predicted_q,\n",
    "        observed_freq,\n",
    "        'o-',\n",
    "        color='teal',\n",
    "        label=f\"{model_name}\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"Predicted Quantile (Confidence Level)\")\n",
    "    ax.set_ylabel(\"Observed Frequency\")\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"Quantile Calibration Curve – {model_name}\")\n",
    "    ax.legend()\n",
    "    fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    img_buffer = BytesIO()\n",
    "    fig.savefig(img_buffer, format=\"png\", dpi=300)\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    img_buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Save to Excel\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    excel_path = Path(excel_path)\n",
    "    excel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sheet_curve = f\"Calibration_Curve_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_summary = f\"Calibration_Summary_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_plot = f\"Calibration_Plot_{model_name}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(\n",
    "        excel_path)),\n",
    "        engine=\"openpyxl\",\n",
    "        mode=\"a\" if excel_path.exists() else \"w\",\n",
    "        if_sheet_exists=\"replace\"\n",
    "    ) as writer:\n",
    "\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        calib_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_curve, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_summary, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "        workbook = writer.book\n",
    "\n",
    "        worksheet = workbook.create_sheet(sheet_plot)\n",
    "\n",
    "        img = openpyxlImage(img_buffer)\n",
    "        img.width = img.width * 0.4\n",
    "        img.height = img.height * 0.4\n",
    "\n",
    "        img.anchor = \"B2\"\n",
    "        worksheet.add_image(img)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"✅ Calibration curve & metrics saved to Excel:\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {excel_path}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return calib_df"
   ]

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "# Define the path to the folder\n",
    "folder_path = \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create the folder if it doesn't exist\n",
    "os.makedirs(folder_path, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "def plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_df, y_true, model_name):\n",
    "    # Calculate metrics\n",
    "    mean_pred = predictions_df['Mean']\n",
    "    std_pred = predictions_df['StdDev']\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Sharpness is the standard deviation\n",
    "    sharpness = std_pred.mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # CRPS for each prediction\n",
    "    crps_values = ps.crps_gaussian(y_true, mean_pred, std_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Negative Log Likelihood (NLL) for each prediction\n",
    "    nll_values = -norm.logpdf(y_true, loc=mean_pred, scale=std_pred)\n",
    "    nll = nll_values.mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calibration (Validity)\n",
    "    percentiles = np.linspace(0, 100, 101)\n",
    "    calibration = [np.mean((y_true <= np.percentile(mean_pred + std_pred * np.random.randn(*mean_pred.shape), p))) for p in percentiles]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create a DataFrame to store the metrics\n",
    "    metrics_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Mean Prediction': mean_pred,\n",
    "        'Standard Deviation': std_pred,\n",
    "        'CRPS': crps_values,\n",
    "        'NLL': nll_values\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add summary statistics\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Metric': ['Sharpness', 'Mean CRPS', 'Mean NLL'],\n",
    "        'Value': [sharpness, crps_values.mean(), nll]\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Write the metrics and summary to the Excel sheet\n",
    "    metrics_sheet_name = f'{model_name} Metrics'\n",
    "    writer\n",
    "    metrics_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=metrics_sheet_name, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_sheet_name = f'{model_name} Summary'\n",
    "    writer\n",
    "    summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=summary_sheet_name, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plotting\n",
    "    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Sharpness plot\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].hist(std_pred, bins=30, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].set_title(f'Sharpness (StdDev) for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].set_xlabel('Standard Deviation')\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # CRPS plot (distribution)\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].hist(crps_values, bins=30, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black')\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].set_title(f'CRPS Distribution for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].set_xlabel('CRPS')\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # NLL plot (distribution)\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].hist(nll_values, bins=30, color='salmon', edgecolor='black')\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].set_title(f'NLL Distribution for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].set_xlabel('NLL')\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calibration plot\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].plot(percentiles, calibration, label='Calibration Curve')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].plot(percentiles, percentiles / 100, linestyle='--', label='Perfect Calibration')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].set_title(f'Calibration (Validity) for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].set_xlabel('Predicted Percentile')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].set_ylabel('Observed Frequency')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save plots to images\n",
    "    plot_image_path = f'{model_name}_plots.png'\n",
    "    fig.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(plot_image_path))\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Insert the plot image into the Excel sheet\n",
    "    sheet_name = f'{model_name} Plots'\n",
    "    if sheet_name not in writer.sheets:  # Check if sheet already exists\n",
    "        # If sheet doesn't exist, create a new one\n",
    "        worksheet = writer.book.add_worksheet(sheet_name)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        # If sheet exists, get the existing sheet object to avoid duplicates\n",
    "        worksheet = writer.sheets[sheet_name]\n",
    "    worksheet.insert_image('A1', plot_image_path)"
   ]
  },

      "Mean Squared Error: 7.29\n",
      "        Mean    StdDev  Actual\n",
      "0  33.389155  0.308892    34.0\n",

   "source": [
    "# Assuming best_params is obtained correctly\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'NGBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove any conflicting parameters from best_params\n",
    "incompatible_keys = ['Dist', 'Score']\n",
    "for key in incompatible_keys:\n",
    "    best_params.pop(key, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Initialize NGBoost model with best_params\n",
    "ngb_model = NGBRegressor(Dist=Normal, **best_params)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Fit the model\n",
    "ngb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Predict the distribution\n",
    "pred_dist = ngb_model.pred_dist(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extract mean and standard deviation\n",
    "predictions_NGB_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': pred_dist.loc,\n",
    "    'StdDev': pred_dist.scale,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test.ravel()\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate and print the mean squared error\n",
    "mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, pred_dist.loc)\n",
    "print(f\"Mean Squared Error: {mse:.2f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Print the DataFrame with mean and standard deviation\n",
    "print(predictions_NGB_df.head())"
   ]
  },

      "3  36.337196  3.055833    35.0\n",
      "4  43.927353  3.091106    44.6\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Assuming best_params is obtained correctly\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'PGBM')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove any conflicting parameters from best_params\n",
    "# Note: Adjust the incompatible keys based on PGBM's requirements\n",
    "incompatible_keys = ['Dist', 'Score']\n",
    "for key in incompatible_keys:\n",
    "    best_params.pop(key, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Initialize PGBM model\n",
    "pgbm_model = PGBM()\n",
    "\n",
    "def mseloss_objective(yhat, y, sample_weight=None):\n",
    "    # Ensure that yhat and y are PyTorch tensors\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(yhat):\n",
    "        yhat = torch.from_numpy(np.array(yhat)).float()\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(y):\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(np.array(y)).float()\n",
    "    gradient = yhat - y\n",
    "    hessian = torch.ones_like(yhat)\n",
    "    return gradient, hessian\n",
    "\n",
    "def rmseloss_metric(yhat, y, sample_weight=None):\n",
    "    # Ensure that yhat and y are PyTorch tensors\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(yhat):\n",
    "        yhat = torch.from_numpy(np.array(yhat)).float()\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(y):\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(np.array(y)).float()\n",
    "    loss = torch.sqrt(torch.mean((yhat - y) ** 2))\n",
    "    return loss\n",
    "\n",
    "X_train = np.array(X_train)\n",
    "y_train = np.array(y_train)\n",
    "X_test = np.array(X_test)\n",
    "y_test = np.array(y_test)\n",
    "# Fit the model\n",
    "pgbm_model.train((X_train, y_train), objective=mseloss_objective, metric=rmseloss_metric, params = best_params)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Predict the distribution\n",
    "pred_dist = pgbm_model.predict_dist(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extract mean and standard deviation\n",
    "# Note: PGBM might return predictions in a different format, adjust accordingly\n",
    "predictions_PGBM_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': pred_dist.mean(axis=0),\n",
    "    'StdDev': pred_dist.std(axis=0),\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test.ravel()\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate and print the mean squared error\n",
    "mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, predictions_PGBM_df['Mean'])\n",
    "print(f\"Mean Squared Error: {mse:.2f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Print the DataFrame with mean and standard deviation\n",
    "print(predictions_PGBM_df.head())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'GPBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "gpboost_score_engine = TreeBasedScoreModel(\n",
    "    model_name='gpboost',\n",
    "    model_params=best_params,\n",
    "    seed=42,\n",
    "    verbose=-1\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# The fix is in the line below: '_score_model' has been corrected to 'score_model'.\n",
    "model = Treeffuser(score_model=gpboost_score_engine, seed=42)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "n_samples_for_prediction = 200\n",
    "y_samples = model.sample(X_test, n_samples=n_samples_for_prediction, verbose=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_samples_obj = Samples(y_samples)\n",
    "mean = y_samples_obj.sample_mean()\n",
    "stddev = y_samples_obj.sample_std()\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_GPBoost_TF_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_GPBoost_TF_df.head())\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'GradientBoosting')\n",
    "\n",
    "gbr_score_engine = TreeBasedScoreModel(\n",
    "    model_name='gradient_boosting',\n",
    "    model_params=best_params,\n",
    "    seed=42,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "model = Treeffuser(score_model=gbr_score_engine, seed=42)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "n_samples_for_prediction = 200\n",
    "y_samples = model.sample(X_test, n_samples=n_samples_for_prediction, verbose=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_samples_obj = Samples(y_samples)\n",
    "mean = y_samples_obj.sample_mean()\n",
    "stddev = y_samples_obj.sample_std()\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_GBR_TF_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_GBR_TF_df.head())\n"
   ]

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'CatBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "catboost_score_engine = TreeBasedScoreModel(\n",
    "    model_name='catboost',\n",
    "    model_params=best_params,\n",
    "    seed=42,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "model = Treeffuser(score_model=catboost_score_engine, seed=42)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "n_samples_for_prediction = 200\n",
    "y_samples = model.sample(X_test, n_samples=n_samples_for_prediction, verbose=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_samples_obj = Samples(y_samples)\n",
    "mean = y_samples_obj.sample_mean()\n",
    "stddev = y_samples_obj.sample_std()\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_CatBoost_TF_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_CatBoost_TF_df.head())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'XGBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "xgb_score_engine = TreeBasedScoreModel(\n",
    "    model_name='xgboost',\n",
    "    model_params=best_params,\n",
    "    seed=42,\n",
    "    verbose=-1\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "model = Treeffuser(score_model=xgb_score_engine, seed=42)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "n_samples_for_prediction = 200\n",
    "y_samples = model.sample(X_test, n_samples=n_samples_for_prediction, verbose=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_samples_obj = Samples(y_samples)\n",
    "mean = y_samples_obj.sample_mean()\n",
    "stddev = y_samples_obj.sample_std()\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_XGB_TF_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_XGB_TF_df.head())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'LightGBM')\n",
    "\n",
    "lgbm_score_engine = TreeBasedScoreModel(\n",
    "    model_name='lightgbm',\n",
    "    model_params=best_params,\n",
    "    seed=42,\n",
    "    verbose=-1\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "model = Treeffuser(score_model=lgbm_score_engine, seed=42)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "n_samples_for_prediction = 200\n",
    "y_samples = model.sample(X_test, n_samples=n_samples_for_prediction, verbose=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_samples_obj = Samples(y_samples)\n",
    "mean = y_samples_obj.sample_mean()\n",
    "stddev = y_samples_obj.sample_std()\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_LGBM_TF_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_LGBM_TF_df.head())\n"
   ]
  },

    "# Clone the repository\n",
    "!git clone https://github.com/jjbrophy47/ibug.git\n",
    "%cd ibug\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build extensions if needed\n",
    "!python setup.py build_ext --inplace\n",
    "\n",
    "# Install the package\n",
    "!pip install .\n",
    "\n",
    "# Verify installation\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    from ibug import IBUGWrapper\n",
    "    print(\"IBUGWrapper imported successfully!\")\n",
    "except ImportError as e:\n",
    "    print(\"Error importing IBUGWrapper:\", e)"
   ]

    "# **Probabilistic Distributions using LGBM (IBUG)**"

   "source": [
    "# Assume hyperparameter tuning has been done and best_params are obtained\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'LightGBM')\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- Ensure IBUG compatibility ---\n",
    "best_params['reg_alpha'] = 0\n",
    "best_params['class_weight'] = None\n",
    "best_params['boosting_type'] = 'gbdt'\n",
    "\n",
    "# Initialize and train the LightGBM regressor using the best_params\n",
    "model = LGBMRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extend the trained model into a probabilistic predictor using IBUGWrapper\n",
    "prob_model = IBUGWrapper().fit(model, X_train, y_train, X_val=X_val, y_val=y_val)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Use the model to predict the probabilistic distribution on the test data.\n",
    "location, scale = prob_model.pred_dist(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Optionally, to also get the k-nearest training indices and their values used in modeling\n",
    "location2, scale2, train_idxs, train_vals = prob_model.pred_dist(X_test, return_kneighbors=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "dev = scale**0.5\n",
    "# Create a DataFrame for clarity\n",
    "predictions_LGBM_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': location,\n",
    "    'StdDev': dev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test,\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_LGBM_df.head())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# **Probabilistic Distributions using XGBoost (IBUG)**"
   ]
  },

      "        Mean    StdDev  Actual\n",
      "0  32.288765  2.562268    34.0\n",
      "1  37.074501  2.611769    36.0\n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Assume hyperparameter tuning has been done and best_params are obtained\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'XGBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "best_params['reg_alpha'] = 0\n",
    "best_params['scale_pos_weight'] = 1\n",
    "best_params['base_score'] = 0.5\n",
    "\n",
    "# Initialize and train the XGBoost regressor using the best_params\n",
    "model = XGBRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extend the trained model into a probabilistic predictor using IBUGWrapper\n",
    "prob_model = IBUGWrapper().fit(model, X_train, y_train, X_val=X_val, y_val=y_val)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Use the model to predict the probabilistic distribution on the test data.\n",
    "# This returns the predicted mean (location) and uncertainty (scale, variance proxy)\n",
    "location, scale = prob_model.pred_dist(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Optionally, to also get the k-nearest training indices and their values used in modeling\n",
    "location, scale, train_idxs, train_vals = prob_model.pred_dist(X_test, return_kneighbors=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate the standard deviation from the variance (scale)\n",
    "std_dev = scale ** 0.5\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a DataFrame for clarity\n",
    "predictions_XGB_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': location,\n",
    "    'StdDev': std_dev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_XGB_df.head())"
   ]
  },

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a Pandas Excel writer using XlsxWriter as the engine.\n",
    "folder_path = \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis\"\n",
    "excel_path = os.path.join(folder_path, \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/probabilistic_distribution/Matrix Evaluation.xlsx\")\n",
    "with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(excel_path), engine='xlsxwriter') as writer:\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_NGB_df, y_test, 'NGBoost')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_PGBM_df, y_test, 'PGBM')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_LGBM_df, y_test, 'LGBM')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_XGB_df, y_test, 'XGBoost')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_LGBM_TF_df, y_test, \"LightGBM_TF\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_XGB_TF_df, y_test, \"XGBoost_TF\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_CatBoost_TF_df, y_test, \"CatBoost_TF\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_GPBoost_TF_df, y_test, \"GPBoost_TF\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_GBR_TF_df, y_test, \"GradientBoosting_TF\")"
   ]
  }

    "def get_best_model_params(results, model_name):\n",
    "    # Map model names to dictionary keys, assuming keys are strings like 'XGBoost' and not objects\n",
    "    model_keys = {\n",
    "        'LightGBM': 'LightGBM',\n",
    "        'XGBoost': 'XGBoost',\n",
    "        'GPBoost': 'GPBoost',\n",
    "        'NGBoost': 'NGBoost',\n",
    "        'GradientBoosting': 'Gradient Boosting',\n",
    "        'HGBR' : 'HistGradientBoosting',\n",
    "        'CatBoost' : 'CatBoost',\n",
    "        'TabNet' : 'TabNet',\n",
    "        'PGBM' : 'PGBM'\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure the requested model name is valid\n",
    "    if model_name not in model_keys:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"Model name '{model_name}' is not recognized. Available models are: {list(model_keys.keys())}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Filter out entries for the specified model\n",
    "    model_entries = {key: value for key, value in results.items() if key[0] == model_keys[model_name]}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Find the entry with the best (lowest) 'best_score'\n",
    "    best_entry_key, best_entry_value = min(model_entries.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]['best_score'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Return the best hyperparameters\n",
    "    return best_entry_value['best_params']"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_crps_decomposition(\n",
    "    predictions_df,\n",
    "    y_true,\n",
    "    excel_path,\n",
    "    model_name=\"Model\",\n",
    "    n_bins=10\n",
    "):\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Input handling\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = predictions_df['StdDev'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    if 'Actual' in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Total CRPS\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    crps_values = ps.crps_gaussian(\n",
    "        y_true, mu=mu_pred, sig=sigma_pred\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    total_crps = np.mean(crps_values)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Uncertainty (climatology)\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    global_mu = np.mean(y_true)\n",
    "    global_sigma = np.std(y_true)\n",
    "\n",
    "    uncertainty = np.mean(\n",
    "        ps.crps_gaussian(y_true, mu=global_mu, sig=global_sigma)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Reliability & Resolution\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    sort_idx = np.argsort(mu_pred)\n",
    "    y_sorted = y_true[sort_idx]\n",
    "    mu_sorted = mu_pred[sort_idx]\n",
    "    sigma_sorted = sigma_pred[sort_idx]\n",
    "\n",
    "    bins = np.array_split(np.arange(len(y_true)), n_bins)\n",
    "\n",
    "    bin_results = []\n",
    "    reliability_sum = 0.0\n",
    "\n",
    "    for i, b in enumerate(bins):\n",
    "        bin_y = y_sorted[b]\n",
    "        bin_mu = mu_sorted[b]\n",
    "        bin_sigma = sigma_sorted[b]\n",
    "\n",
    "        bin_crps = np.mean(\n",
    "            ps.crps_gaussian(bin_y, mu=bin_mu, sig=bin_sigma)\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        reliability_sum += bin_crps\n",
    "\n",
    "        bin_results.append({\n",
    "            \"Bin\": i + 1,\n",
    "            \"Bin_Size\": len(b),\n",
    "            \"Mean_Pred_Mu\": np.mean(bin_mu),\n",
    "            \"Mean_Pred_Sigma\": np.mean(bin_sigma),\n",
    "            \"Bin_CRPS\": bin_crps\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "    reliability = reliability_sum / n_bins\n",
    "    resolution = uncertainty - (total_crps - reliability)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Summary table\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"Total_CRPS\": total_crps,\n",
    "        \"Reliability\": reliability,\n",
    "        \"Resolution\": resolution,\n",
    "        \"Uncertainty\": uncertainty,\n",
    "        \"Num_Bins\": n_bins\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    bin_df = pd.DataFrame(bin_results)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Save to Excel\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    excel_path = Path(excel_path)\n",
    "    excel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sheet_summary = f\"CRPS_Summary_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_bins = f\"CRPS_Bins_{model_name}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(\n",
    "        excel_path)),\n",
    "        engine=\"openpyxl\",\n",
    "        mode=\"a\" if excel_path.exists() else \"w\",\n",
    "        if_sheet_exists=\"replace\"\n",
    "    ) as writer:\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_summary, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        bin_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_bins, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"✅ CRPS decomposition saved to:\\n{excel_path}\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   Sheets: {sheet_summary}, {sheet_bins}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return summary_df"
   ]
  },

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_pit_results(\n",
    "    predictions_df,\n",
    "    y_true,\n",
    "    excel_path,\n",
    "    model_name=\"Model\",\n",
    "    n_bins=10\n",
    "):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Generate PIT values, histogram, calibration diagnostics,\n",
    "    and save everything to Excel with the PIT plot EMBEDDED.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Input handling\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = predictions_df['StdDev'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    if 'Actual' in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    sigma_pred = np.clip(sigma_pred, 1e-6, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Compute PIT values\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    pit_values = norm.cdf(y_true, loc=mu_pred, scale=sigma_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "    pit_df = pd.DataFrame({\"PIT_Value\": pit_values})\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Histogram data\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    hist_density, bin_edges = np.histogram(\n",
    "        pit_values, bins=n_bins, range=(0, 1), density=True\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    bin_centers = 0.5 * (bin_edges[:-1] + bin_edges[1:])\n",
    "\n",
    "    hist_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        \"Bin_Center\": bin_centers,\n",
    "        \"Density\": hist_density\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Calibration diagnostics\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    pit_mean = pit_values.mean()\n",
    "    pit_var = pit_values.var()\n",
    "    ks_stat, ks_pvalue = kstest(pit_values, 'uniform')\n",
    "\n",
    "    if ks_pvalue > 0.05:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Well-calibrated (Uniform PIT)\"\n",
    "    elif pit_var < 1/12:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Over-dispersed (Under-confident)\"\n",
    "    elif pit_var > 1/12:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Under-dispersed (Over-confident)\"\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        diagnosis = \"Biased or miscalibrated\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"Mean_PIT\": pit_mean,\n",
    "        \"Variance_PIT\": pit_var,\n",
    "        \"Ideal_Variance_(1/12)\": 1/12,\n",
    "        \"KS_Statistic\": ks_stat,\n",
    "        \"KS_pvalue\": ks_pvalue,\n",
    "        \"Calibration_Diagnosis\": diagnosis\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Create PIT plot in memory\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
    "    ax.hist(\n",
    "        pit_values,\n",
    "        bins=n_bins,\n",
    "        density=True,\n",
    "        color=\"skyblue\",\n",
    "        edgecolor=\"black\",\n",
    "        alpha=0.75\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    ax.axhline(1, color=\"red\", linestyle=\"--\", label=\"Perfect Calibration\")\n",
    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"PIT Value\")\n",
    "    ax.set_ylabel(\"Density\")\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"PIT Histogram – {model_name}\")\n",
    "    ax.legend()\n",
    "    fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    img_buffer = BytesIO()\n",
    "    fig.savefig(img_buffer, format=\"png\", dpi=300)\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    img_buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Save to Excel\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    excel_path = Path(excel_path)\n",
    "    excel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sheet_values = f\"PIT_Values_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_hist = f\"PIT_Histogram_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_summary = f\"PIT_Summary_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_plot = f\"PIT_Plot_{model_name}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(\n",
    "        excel_path)),\n",
    "        engine=\"openpyxl\",\n",
    "        mode=\"a\" if excel_path.exists() else \"w\",\n",
    "        if_sheet_exists=\"replace\"\n",
    "    ) as writer:\n",
    "\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        pit_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_values, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        hist_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_hist, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_summary, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Create empty sheet for plot\n",
    "        workbook = writer.book\n",
    "        worksheet = workbook.create_sheet(sheet_plot)\n",
    "\n",
    "        img = openpyxlImage(img_buffer)\n",
    "        img.width = img.width * 0.4\n",
    "        img.height = img.height * 0.4\n",
    "\n",
    "        img.anchor = \"B2\"\n",
    "        worksheet.add_image(img)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"✅ PIT values, histogram, summary, and EMBEDDED plot saved to:\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {excel_path}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pit_df"
   ]

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def generate_and_save_calibration_curve(\n",
    "    predictions_df,\n",
    "    y_true,\n",
    "    excel_path,\n",
    "    model_name=\"Model\",\n",
    "    n_quantiles=10\n",
    "):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Generate quantile calibration curve (reliability diagram),\n",
    "    compute calibration errors, and save everything to Excel\n",
    "    with the plot EMBEDDED.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Input handling\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mu_pred = predictions_df['Mean'].values\n",
    "    sigma_pred = predictions_df['StdDev'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    if 'Actual' in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        y_true = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "\n",
    "    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()\n",
    "    sigma_pred = np.clip(sigma_pred, 1e-6, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Quantiles\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    quantiles = np.linspace(0, 1, n_quantiles + 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    observed_freq = []\n",
    "    predicted_q = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for q in quantiles:\n",
    "        # Predicted value at quantile q\n",
    "        thresh = norm.ppf(q, loc=mu_pred, scale=sigma_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Observed frequency\n",
    "        obs = np.mean(y_true <= thresh)\n",
    "\n",
    "        predicted_q.append(q)\n",
    "        observed_freq.append(obs)\n",
    "\n",
    "    predicted_q = np.array(predicted_q)\n",
    "    observed_freq = np.array(observed_freq)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Calibration metrics\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    mce = np.mean(np.abs(observed_freq - predicted_q))\n",
    "    rmsce = np.sqrt(np.mean((observed_freq - predicted_q) ** 2))\n",
    "\n",
    "    calib_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        \"Predicted_Quantile\": predicted_q,\n",
    "        \"Observed_Frequency\": observed_freq,\n",
    "        \"Absolute_Error\": np.abs(observed_freq - predicted_q)\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame([{\n",
    "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"Mean_Calibration_Error (MCE)\": mce,\n",
    "        \"RMS_Calibration_Error (RMSCE)\": rmsce,\n",
    "        \"Num_Quantiles\": n_quantiles\n",
    "    }])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Create calibration plot\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', label=\"Perfect Calibration\")\n",
    "    ax.plot(\n",
    "        predicted_q,\n",
    "        observed_freq,\n",
    "        'o-',\n",
    "        color='teal',\n",
    "        label=f\"{model_name}\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"Predicted Quantile (Confidence Level)\")\n",
    "    ax.set_ylabel(\"Observed Frequency\")\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"Quantile Calibration Curve – {model_name}\")\n",
    "    ax.legend()\n",
    "    fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    img_buffer = BytesIO()\n",
    "    fig.savefig(img_buffer, format=\"png\", dpi=300)\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    img_buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    # Save to Excel\n",
    "    # -------------------------------\n",
    "    excel_path = Path(excel_path)\n",
    "    excel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    sheet_curve = f\"Calibration_Curve_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_summary = f\"Calibration_Summary_{model_name}\"\n",
    "    sheet_plot = f\"Calibration_Plot_{model_name}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(_ensure_excel_file(\n",
    "        excel_path)),\n",
    "        engine=\"openpyxl\",\n",
    "        mode=\"a\" if excel_path.exists() else \"w\",\n",
    "        if_sheet_exists=\"replace\"\n",
    "    ) as writer:\n",
    "\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        calib_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_curve, index=False)\n",
    "        writer\n",
    "        summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_summary, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "        workbook = writer.book\n",
    "\n",
    "        worksheet = workbook.create_sheet(sheet_plot)\n",
    "\n",
    "        img = openpyxlImage(img_buffer)\n",
    "        img.width = img.width * 0.4\n",
    "        img.height = img.height * 0.4\n",
    "\n",
    "        img.anchor = \"B2\"\n",
    "        worksheet.add_image(img)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"✅ Calibration curve & metrics saved to Excel:\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {excel_path}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return calib_df"
   ]

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "# Define the path to the folder\n",
    "folder_path = \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create the folder if it doesn't exist\n",
    "os.makedirs(folder_path, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "def plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_df, y_true, model_name):\n",
    "    # Calculate metrics\n",
    "    mean_pred = predictions_df['Mean']\n",
    "    std_pred = predictions_df['StdDev']\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Sharpness is the standard deviation\n",
    "    sharpness = std_pred.mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # CRPS for each prediction\n",
    "    crps_values = ps.crps_gaussian(y_true, mean_pred, std_pred)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Negative Log Likelihood (NLL) for each prediction\n",
    "    nll_values = -norm.logpdf(y_true, loc=mean_pred, scale=std_pred)\n",
    "    nll = nll_values.mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calibration (Validity)\n",
    "    percentiles = np.linspace(0, 100, 101)\n",
    "    calibration = [np.mean((y_true <= np.percentile(mean_pred + std_pred * np.random.randn(*mean_pred.shape), p))) for p in percentiles]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create a DataFrame to store the metrics\n",
    "    metrics_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Mean Prediction': mean_pred,\n",
    "        'Standard Deviation': std_pred,\n",
    "        'CRPS': crps_values,\n",
    "        'NLL': nll_values\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add summary statistics\n",
    "    summary_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        'Metric': ['Sharpness', 'Mean CRPS', 'Mean NLL'],\n",
    "        'Value': [sharpness, crps_values.mean(), nll]\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Write the metrics and summary to the Excel sheet\n",
    "    metrics_sheet_name = f'{model_name} Metrics'\n",
    "    writer\n",
    "    metrics_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=metrics_sheet_name, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    summary_sheet_name = f'{model_name} Summary'\n",
    "    writer\n",
    "    summary_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=summary_sheet_name, index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plotting\n",
    "    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Sharpness plot\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].hist(std_pred, bins=30, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].set_title(f'Sharpness (StdDev) for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].set_xlabel('Standard Deviation')\n",
    "    axs[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # CRPS plot (distribution)\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].hist(crps_values, bins=30, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black')\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].set_title(f'CRPS Distribution for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].set_xlabel('CRPS')\n",
    "    axs[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # NLL plot (distribution)\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].hist(nll_values, bins=30, color='salmon', edgecolor='black')\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].set_title(f'NLL Distribution for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].set_xlabel('NLL')\n",
    "    axs[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calibration plot\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].plot(percentiles, calibration, label='Calibration Curve')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].plot(percentiles, percentiles / 100, linestyle='--', label='Perfect Calibration')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].set_title(f'Calibration (Validity) for {model_name}')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].set_xlabel('Predicted Percentile')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].set_ylabel('Observed Frequency')\n",
    "    axs[1, 1].legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save plots to images\n",
    "    plot_image_path = f'{model_name}_plots.png'\n",
    "    fig.savefig(_ensure_parent_dir(plot_image_path))\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Insert the plot image into the Excel sheet\n",
    "    sheet_name = f'{model_name} Plots'\n",
    "    if sheet_name not in writer.sheets:  # Check if sheet already exists\n",
    "        # If sheet doesn't exist, create a new one\n",
    "        worksheet = writer.book.add_worksheet(sheet_name)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        # If sheet exists, get the existing sheet object to avoid duplicates\n",
    "        worksheet = writer.sheets[sheet_name]\n",
    "    worksheet.insert_image('A1', plot_image_path)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "class CARDRegressor:\n",
    "    def __init__(\n",
    "        self,\n",
    "        base_model,\n",
    "        hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "        T=50,\n",
    "        lr=1e-3,\n",
    "        epochs=200,\n",
    "        n_samples=100,\n",
    "        device=\"cpu\"\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        self.base_model = base_model\n",
    "        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim\n",
    "        self.T = T\n",
    "        self.epochs = epochs\n",
    "        self.n_samples = n_samples\n",
    "        self.device = device\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.mlp = None  # ← FIX\n",
    "        self.loss_fn = torch.nn.MSELoss()\n",
    "        self.optimizer = None\n",
    "\n",
    "    def fit(self, X, y):\n",
    "        # Base predictions\n",
    "        y_pred = self.base_model.predict(X)\n",
    "        residuals = y - y_pred\n",
    "\n",
    "        X_t = torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "        r_t = torch.tensor(residuals, dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build MLP HERE (now input dim is known)\n",
    "        self.mlp = torch.nn.Sequential(\n",
    "            torch.nn.Linear(X.shape[1] + 1, self.hidden_dim),\n",
    "            torch.nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            torch.nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.hidden_dim),\n",
    "            torch.nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            torch.nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, 1)\n",
    "        ).to(self.device)\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(self.mlp.parameters(), lr=1e-3)\n",
    "\n",
    "        for _ in range(self.epochs):\n",
    "            t = torch.randint(0, self.T, (len(X_t),), dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "            noise = torch.randn_like(r_t)\n",
    "\n",
    "            pred_noise = self.mlp(\n",
    "                torch.cat([X_t, t.unsqueeze(1)], dim=1)\n",
    "            ).squeeze()\n",
    "\n",
    "            loss = self.loss_fn(pred_noise, noise)\n",
    "\n",
    "            self.optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
    "            loss.backward()\n",
    "            self.optimizer.step()\n",
    "\n",
    "    def predict(self, X):\n",
    "        base_pred = self.base_model.predict(X)\n",
    "        X_t = torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "\n",
    "        samples = []\n",
    "        for _ in range(self.n_samples):\n",
    "            t = torch.zeros(len(X_t))\n",
    "            noise = torch.randn(len(X_t))\n",
    "\n",
    "            pred_noise = self.mlp(\n",
    "                torch.cat([X_t, t.unsqueeze(1)], dim=1)\n",
    "            ).detach().squeeze()\n",
    "\n",
    "            samples.append(base_pred + (noise - pred_noise).numpy())\n",
    "\n",
    "        samples = np.stack(samples, axis=1)\n",
    "        return samples.mean(axis=1), samples.std(axis=1)\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'LightGBM')\n",
    "\n",
    "lgbm_model = LGBMRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "lgbm_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=lgbm_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_LGBM_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_LGBM_df.head())\n"
   ]
  },

    "# **Probabilistic Distribution using XGBoost**"

  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "metadata": {
    "colab": {
     "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
    },
    "executionInfo": {
     "elapsed": 522,
     "status": "ok",

   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "        Mean    StdDev  Actual\n",
      "0  32.011032  1.028041    34.0\n",
      "1  35.718273  0.922281    36.0\n",
      "2  34.460888  0.902895    36.0\n",

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'XGBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "xgb_model = XGBRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "xgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=xgb_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_XGB_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'GPBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "gpboost_model = GPBoostRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "gpboost_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=gpboost_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_GPBoost_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_GPBoost_df.head())"
   ]
  },

     "output_type": "stream",

     "text": [
      "Mean Squared Error: 9.81\n",
      "        Mean    StdDev  Actual\n",
      "0  33.047414  1.003655    34.0\n",
      "1  35.128112  0.953045    36.0\n",
      "2  34.165208  0.943637    36.0\n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'NGBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "incompatible_keys = ['Dist', 'Score']\n",
    "for key in incompatible_keys:\n",
    "    best_params.pop(key, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "ngb_model = NGBRegressor(Dist=Normal, **best_params)\n",
    "\n",
    "ngb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=ngb_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=100\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean_pred, std_pred = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_NGB_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"Mean\": mean_pred,\n",
    "    \"StdDev\": std_pred,\n",
    "    \"Actual\": y_test.ravel()\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, mean_pred)\n",
    "print(f\"Mean Squared Error: {mse:.2f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_NGB_df.head())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'GradientBoosting')\n",
    "\n",
    "gbr_model = GradientBoostingRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "gbr_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=gbr_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_GBR_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_GBR_df.head())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'CatBoost')\n",
    "\n",
    "catboost_model = CatBoostRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    "catboost_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=catboost_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_CatBoost_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    'Mean': mean,\n",
    "    'StdDev': stddev,\n",
    "    'Actual': y_test\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_CatBoost_df.head())\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'HGBR')\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "hgb_model = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(\n",
    "    **best_params,\n",
    ")\n",
    "hgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=hgb_model,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_HGBR_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"Mean\": mean,\n",
    "    \"StdDev\": stddev,\n",
    "    \"Actual\": y_test.values.ravel()\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_HGBR_df.head())\n"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

   "outputs": [

     "output_type": "stream",

     "text": [
      "        Mean    StdDev  Actual\n",
      "0  30.566771  0.997741    34.0\n",
      "1  33.057095  1.066381    36.0\n",
      "2  35.161186  1.030714    36.0\n",

   "source": [
    "class TabNetMeanWrapper:\n",
    "    def __init__(self, model):\n",
    "        self.model = model\n",
    "\n",
    "    def fit(self, X, y):\n",
    "        X = np.asarray(X)\n",
    "        y = np.asarray(y).reshape(-1, 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.model.fit(\n",
    "            X,\n",
    "            y,\n",
    "            max_epochs=200,\n",
    "            patience=30,\n",
    "            batch_size=1024,\n",
    "            virtual_batch_size=128,\n",
    "            num_workers=0,\n",
    "            drop_last=False\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    def predict(self, X):\n",
    "        X = np.asarray(X)\n",
    "        return self.model.predict(X).reshape(-1)\n",
    "\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'TabNet')\n",
    "\n",
    "tabnet_base = TabNetMeanWrapper(\n",
    "    TabNetRegressor(**best_params)\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "tabnet_base.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=tabnet_base,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=200\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "mean, stddev = card_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "predictions_TabNet_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"Mean\": mean,\n",
    "    \"StdDev\": stddev,\n",
    "    \"Actual\": y_test.values\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "print(predictions_TabNet_df.head())\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# Assuming best_params is obtained correctly\n",
    "best_params = get_best_model_params(best_scores_autosampler, 'PGBM')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove any conflicting parameters (safe-guard)\n",
    "for key in ['Dist', 'Score']:\n",
    "    best_params.pop(key, None)\n",
    "\n",
    "# -------------------------\n",
    "# Train PGBM as BASE model\n",
    "# -------------------------\n",
    "pgbm_model = PGBM()\n",
    "\n",
    "def mseloss_objective(yhat, y, sample_weight=None):\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(yhat):\n",
    "        yhat = torch.from_numpy(np.array(yhat)).float()\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(y):\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(np.array(y)).float()\n",
    "    gradient = yhat - y\n",
    "    hessian = torch.ones_like(yhat)\n",
    "    return gradient, hessian\n",
    "\n",
    "def rmseloss_metric(yhat, y, sample_weight=None):\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(yhat):\n",
    "        yhat = torch.from_numpy(np.array(yhat)).float()\n",
    "    if not torch.is_tensor(y):\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(np.array(y)).float()\n",
    "    return torch.sqrt(torch.mean((yhat - y) ** 2))\n",
    "\n",
    "X_train_np = np.array(X_train)\n",
    "y_train_np = np.array(y_train)\n",
    "X_test_np = np.array(X_test)\n",
    "y_test_np = np.array(y_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "pgbm_model.train(\n",
    "    (X_train_np, y_train_np),\n",
    "    objective=mseloss_objective,\n",
    "    metric=rmseloss_metric,\n",
    "    params=best_params\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# -------------------------\n",
    "# 🔧 NUMPY-SAFE WRAPPER\n",
    "# -------------------------\n",
    "class PGBMWrapper:\n",
    "    def __init__(self, model):\n",
    "        self.model = model\n",
    "\n",
    "    def predict(self, X):\n",
    "        y_pred = self.model.predict(X)\n",
    "        if torch.is_tensor(y_pred):\n",
    "            y_pred = y_pred.detach().cpu().numpy()\n",
    "        return y_pred\n",
    "\n",
    "pgbm_wrapped = PGBMWrapper(pgbm_model)\n",
    "\n",
    "# -------------------------\n",
    "# CARD wrapper on top\n",
    "# -------------------------\n",
    "card_model = CARDRegressor(\n",
    "    base_model=pgbm_wrapped,\n",
    "    hidden_dim=128,\n",
    "    T=50,\n",
    "    epochs=200,\n",
    "    n_samples=100\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Fit CARD (NOW SAFE)\n",
    "card_model.fit(X_train_np, y_train_np)\n",
    "\n",
    "# CARD predictions\n",
    "mean_pred, std_pred = card_model.predict(X_test_np)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create prediction DataFrame\n",
    "predictions_PGBM_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"Mean\": mean_pred,\n",
    "    \"StdDev\": std_pred,\n",
    "    \"Actual\": y_test_np.ravel()\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate and print MSE\n",
    "mse = mean_squared_error(y_test_np, mean_pred)\n",
    "print(f\"Mean Squared Error: {mse:.2f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Preview results\n",
    "print(predictions_PGBM_df.head())"
   ]
  },

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a Pandas Excel writer using XlsxWriter as the engine.\n",
    "folder_path = \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis\"\n",
    "excel_path = os.path.join(folder_path, \"/content/drive/MyDrive/Regression/concrete_uncertainty_analysis/probabilistic_distribution_card/Matrix Evaluation.xlsx\")\n",
    "with pd.ExcelWriter(_ensure_parent_dir(excel_path), engine='xlsxwriter') as writer:\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_NGB_df, y_test, 'NGBoost')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_PGBM_df, y_test, 'PGBM')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_LGBM_df, y_test, 'LGBM')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_XGB_df, y_test, 'XGBoost')\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_TabNet_df, y_test, \"TabNet\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_HGBR_df, y_test, \"HGBM\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_CatBoost_df, y_test, \"CatBoost\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_GPBoost_df, y_test, \"GPBoost\")\n",
    "    plot_metrics_and_save_to_excel(writer, predictions_GBR_df, y_test, \"GradientBoosting\")"

    "def get_best_model_params(results, model_name):\n",
    "    # Map model names to dictionary keys, assuming keys are strings like 'XGBoost' and not objects\n",
    "    model_keys = {\n",
    "        'LightGBM': 'LightGBM',\n",
    "        'XGBoost': 'XGBoost',\n",
    "        'GPBoost': 'GPBoost',\n",
    "        'NGBoost': 'NGBoost',\n",
    "        'GradientBoosting': 'Gradient Boosting',\n",
    "        'HGBR' : 'HistGradientBoosting',\n",
    "        'CatBoost' : 'CatBoost',\n",
    "        'TabNet' : 'TabNet',\n",
    "        'PGBM' : 'PGBM'\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure the requested model name is valid\n",
    "    if model_name not in model_keys:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"Model name '{model_name}' is not recognized. Available models are: {list(model_keys.keys())}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Filter out entries for the specified model\n",
    "    model_entries = {key: value for key, value in results.items() if key[0] == model_keys[model_name]}\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Find the entry with the best (lowest) 'best_score'\n",
    "    best_entry_key, best_entry_value = min(model_entries.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]['best_score'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Return the best hyperparameters\n",
    "    return best_entry_value['best_params']"
   ]
  },

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def quantile_regression_print(predictions_df, file_path):\n",
    "    # Extract actual values\n",
    "    actual_values = predictions_df['Actual'].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Debugging: Print the first few actual values\n",
    "    print(\"First few actual values:\", actual_values[:5])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculate coverage for the specific interval (0.05 to 0.95)\n",
    "    lower_quantile = 0.05\n",
    "    median_quantile = 0.5\n",
    "    upper_quantile = 0.95\n",
    "\n",
    "    lower_preds = predictions_df[lower_quantile].values\n",
    "    median_preds = predictions_df[median_quantile].values\n",
    "    upper_preds = predictions_df[upper_quantile].values\n",
    "\n",
    "    in_interval = ((actual_values >= lower_preds) & (actual_values <= upper_preds))\n",
    "    coverage = in_interval.mean()\n",
    "    print(f\"Coverage of 90% prediction interval: {coverage * 100:.2f}%\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create a new Excel workbook and add a worksheet\n",
    "    wb = Workbook()\n",
    "    ws = wb.active\n",
    "    ws.title = \"quantile_regression_print\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot actual vs. all predicted quantiles\n",
    "    num_points = len(predictions_df)\n",
    "    indices = np.arange(num_points)\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
    "    plt.plot(indices, actual_values[:num_points], label='Actual str', marker='o', linestyle='-', color='black')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Loop over all columns assumed to be quantile predictions\n",
    "    for column in predictions_df.columns:\n",
    "        if column != 'Actual':  # Skip the actual values column\n",
    "            plt.plot(indices, predictions_df[column][:num_points],\n",
    "                     label=f'Predicted Quantile {column}', linestyle='--')\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Sample Number')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('str')\n",
    "    plt.title('Actual vs. Predicted Quantile str')\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize='small', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), borderaxespad=0.)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save the plot to a BytesIO object\n",
    "    img_data = BytesIO()\n",
    "    img_data\n",
    "    plt.savefig(img_data, format='png', bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    img_data.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Insert the image into the Excel sheet\n",
    "    img = Image(img_data)\n",
    "    ws.add_image(img, 'A1')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot actual values and specific prediction intervals (0.05, 0.5, 0.95)\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
    "    plt.plot(indices, actual_values, label='Actual str', marker='o', linestyle='-', color='black')  # Connect points with a line\n",
    "    plt.plot(indices, median_preds, label=f'Median Prediction ({median_quantile})', marker='x', linestyle='-', color='blue')\n",
    "    plt.fill_between(\n",
    "        indices,\n",
    "        lower_preds,\n",
    "        upper_preds,\n",
    "        color='blue',\n",
    "        alpha=0.5,\n",
    "        label=f'Prediction Interval ({lower_quantile}-{upper_quantile})'\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Sample Number')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(' str')\n",
    "    plt.title('Actual str with Prediction Intervals')\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize='small', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save the second plot to another BytesIO object\n",
    "    img_data = BytesIO()\n",
    "    img_data\n",
    "    plt.savefig(img_data, format='png', bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    img_data.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Insert the second image into the Excel sheet\n",
    "    img = Image(img_data)\n",
    "    ws.add_image(img, 'A30')  # Adjust the cell position as needed\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save the workbook\n",
    "    _ensure_parent_dir(file_path)\n",
    "    wb.save(_ensure_parent_dir(file_path))"
   ]

    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "def _ensure_parent_dir(path):\n",
    "    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n",
    "    if parent:\n",
    "        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "    return path\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "def evaluation_features_print(predictions_df, X_test, file_path):\n",
    "    # Ensure X_test is a DataFrame\n",
    "    if isinstance(X_test, np.ndarray):\n",
    "        X_test = pd.DataFrame(X_test, columns=feature_names)\n",
    "    X_test.columns = feature_names\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Get quantile columns from predictions_df except 'Actual'\n",
    "    quantile_columns = [col for col in predictions_df.columns if col != 'Actual']\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Check if the Excel file already exists\n",
    "    if os.path.exists(file_path):\n",
    "        wb = load_workbook(_ensure_excel_file(file_path))\n",
    "        ws = wb.create_sheet(title=\"New Evaluation Features\")\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        wb = Workbook()\n",
    "        ws = wb.active\n",
    "        ws.title = \"evaluation_features_print\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    image_row = 1  # Where to start images\n",
    "\n",
    "    for feature_to_plot in feature_names:\n",
    "        feature_values = X_test[feature_to_plot]\n",
    "        plot_df = predictions_df.copy()\n",
    "        plot_df[feature_to_plot] = feature_values.values\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Sort by current feature to plot lines well\n",
    "        plot_df = plot_df.sort_values(by=feature_to_plot)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Begin Matplotlib plot\n",
    "        plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))\n",
    "        # Plot each quantile as a line\n",
    "        for quantile in quantile_columns:\n",
    "            plt.plot(plot_df[feature_to_plot], plot_df[quantile], label=f\"{quantile}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Plot actual values as scatter\n",
    "        plt.scatter(plot_df[feature_to_plot], plot_df['Actual'], color='black', s=12, label=\"Actual str\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.title(f\"Predicted Quantiles vs. {feature_to_plot}\")\n",
    "        plt.xlabel(feature_to_plot)\n",
    "        plt.ylabel(\"str\")\n",
    "        plt.legend(loc='center left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.5))\n",
    "        plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Save figure to a BytesIO stream\n",
    "        img_bytes = BytesIO()\n",
    "        img_bytes\n",
    "        plt.savefig(img_bytes, format=\"png\")\n",
    "        plt.close()\n",
    "        img_bytes.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "        img = Image(img_bytes)\n",
    "        img.anchor = f\"A{image_row}\"\n",
    "        ws.add_image(img)\n",
    "\n",
    "        image_row += 20  # Adjust as you like\n",
    "\n",
    "    _ensure_parent_dir(file_path)\n",
    "    wb.save(_ensure_parent_dir(file_path))"
   ]

    "def evaluate_uncertainity_matrix(predictions_df, quantiles, excel_file_path, model_name='Model'):\n",
    "\n",
    "   # Extract the actual target values\n",
    "    y_true = predictions_df['Actual']\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Open existing Excel file\n",
    "    wb = load_workbook(_ensure_excel_file(excel_file_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create unique sheet names\n",
    "    def get_unique_sheet_name(wb, base_name):\n",
    "        sheet_name = base_name\n",
    "        i = 1\n",
    "        while sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:\n",
    "            sheet_name = f\"{base_name}_{i}\"\n",
    "            i += 1\n",
    "        return sheet_name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create separate sheets for plots and values\n",
    "    plots_sheet_title = get_unique_sheet_name(wb, 'Plots')\n",
    "    values_sheet_title = get_unique_sheet_name(wb, 'Values')\n",
    "\n",
    "    ws_plots = wb.create_sheet(title=plots_sheet_title)\n",
    "    ws_values = wb.create_sheet(title=values_sheet_title)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Positions to place images\n",
    "    image_positions = ['A1', 'A25', 'A49', 'A73']  # Adjust as needed\n",
    "\n",
    "    ### 1. Validity / Coverage ###\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Compute empirical coverage for each quantile\n",
    "    empirical_quantiles = []\n",
    "    for q in quantiles:\n",
    "        coverage = (predictions_df[q] >= y_true).mean()\n",
    "        empirical_quantiles.append(coverage)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot theoretical quantiles vs empirical quantiles\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "    sns.lineplot(x=quantiles, y=quantiles, color=\"magenta\", linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=\"Ideal\")\n",
    "    sns.lineplot(x=quantiles, y=empirical_quantiles, color=\"blue\", linewidth=2, label=\"Empirical\")\n",
    "    sns.scatterplot(x=quantiles, y=empirical_quantiles, color=\"blue\", s=50)\n",
    "    plt.xlabel(\"Nominal Quantile Levels\")\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(\"Empirical Quantile Levels\")\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"Validity / Coverage - {model_name}\")\n",
    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save plot to buffer\n",
    "    buffer = io.BytesIO()\n",
    "    buffer\n",
    "    plt.savefig(buffer, format='png')\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create an Image object\n",
    "    img = openpyxlImage(buffer)\n",
    "    img.width = 640\n",
    "    img.height = 480\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add the image to the plots worksheet\n",
    "    ws_plots.add_image(img, image_positions[0])\n",
    "\n",
    "    ### 2. Sharpness / Interval Length ###\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Define coverage levels to evaluate\n",
    "    coverage_levels = [0.6, 0.8, 0.9]\n",
    "    average_interval_lengths = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Compute average interval lengths for each coverage level\n",
    "    for c in coverage_levels:\n",
    "        lower_q = (1 - c) / 2\n",
    "        upper_q = 1 - lower_q\n",
    "        # Find the nearest quantiles in our quantiles list\n",
    "        lower_quantile = min(quantiles, key=lambda x: abs(x - lower_q))\n",
    "        upper_quantile = min(quantiles, key=lambda x: abs(x - upper_q))\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Compute interval length for each observation\n",
    "        interval_length = predictions_df[upper_quantile] - predictions_df[lower_quantile]\n",
    "        avg_interval_length = interval_length.mean()\n",
    "        average_interval_lengths.append(avg_interval_length)\n",
    "        # Write interval length information to the values worksheet\n",
    "        ws_values.append([f'Coverage level: {c*100:.0f}%', f'Interval: [{lower_quantile}, {upper_quantile}]', f'Average Interval Length: {avg_interval_length:.4f}'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot coverage levels vs average interval lengths\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "    plt.plot([c*100 for c in coverage_levels], average_interval_lengths, marker='o')\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Coverage Level (%)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Average Interval Length')\n",
    "    plt.title(f'Sharpness / Interval Length - {model_name}')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save plot to buffer\n",
    "    buffer = io.BytesIO()\n",
    "    buffer\n",
    "    plt.savefig(buffer, format='png')\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create an Image object\n",
    "    img = openpyxlImage(buffer)\n",
    "    img.width = 640\n",
    "    img.height = 480\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add image to the plots worksheet\n",
    "    ws_plots.add_image(img, image_positions[1])\n",
    "\n",
    "    ### 3. Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) ###\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Use the 5th and 95th percentiles to estimate standard deviation\n",
    "    if 0.05 in quantiles and 0.95 in quantiles:\n",
    "        z_lower = norm.ppf(0.05)  # z-score for 5% quantile (~ -1.6449)\n",
    "        z_upper = norm.ppf(0.95)  # z-score for 95% quantile (~ +1.6449)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Extract quantile predictions\n",
    "        q_lower = predictions_df[0.05]\n",
    "        q_upper = predictions_df[0.95]\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif 0.1 in quantiles and 0.9 in quantiles:\n",
    "        z_lower = norm.ppf(0.1)  # z-score for 10% quantile (~ -1.2816)\n",
    "        z_upper = norm.ppf(0.9)  # z-score for 90% quantile (~ +1.2816)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Extract quantile predictions\n",
    "        q_lower = predictions_df[0.1]\n",
    "        q_upper = predictions_df[0.9]\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(\"Required quantiles for NLL estimation not found in quantiles list.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Use median as the mean estimate\n",
    "    if 0.5 in quantiles:\n",
    "        q_median = predictions_df[0.5]\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        # If 0.5 quantile is not available, use the middle quantile\n",
    "        q_median = predictions_df[quantiles[len(quantiles)/2]]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Estimate standard deviation for each observation\n",
    "    std_estimates = (q_upper - q_lower) / (z_upper - z_lower)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure standard deviations are positive and non-zero\n",
    "    std_estimates = std_estimates.clip(lower=1e-6)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Extract mean estimates (median predictions)\n",
    "    mean_estimates = q_median\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Compute Negative Log-Likelihood for each observation\n",
    "    nll = -norm.logpdf(y_true, loc=mean_estimates, scale=std_estimates)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Compute average NLL\n",
    "    average_nll = nll.mean()\n",
    "    # Write average NLL to the values worksheet\n",
    "    ws_values.append(['Average Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL)', average_nll])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Write NLL values to the values worksheet\n",
    "    ws_values.append(['NLL Values'])\n",
    "    for value in nll:\n",
    "        ws_values.append([value])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot ECDF of NLL values\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "    sns.ecdfplot(nll, color='blue', linewidth=2)\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('ECDF')\n",
    "    plt.title(f'NLL ECDF - {model_name}')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save plot to buffer\n",
    "    buffer = io.BytesIO()\n",
    "    buffer\n",
    "    plt.savefig(buffer, format='png')\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create an Image object\n",
    "    img = openpyxlImage(buffer)\n",
    "    img.width = 640\n",
    "    img.height = 480\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add image to the plots worksheet\n",
    "    ws_plots.add_image(img, image_positions[2])\n",
    "\n",
    "    ### 4. Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) ###\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Prepare ensemble of quantile predictions for each observation\n",
    "    ensemble_predictions = predictions_df[quantiles].to_numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure quantile predictions are sorted for each observation\n",
    "    ensemble_predictions.sort(axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Compute CRPS for each observation using ensemble predictions\n",
    "    crps_values = ps.crps_ensemble(y_true, ensemble_predictions)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Compute average CRPS\n",
    "    average_crps = crps_values.mean()\n",
    "    # Write average CRPS to the values worksheet\n",
    "    ws_values.append(['Average Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS)', average_crps])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Write CRPS values to the values worksheet\n",
    "    ws_values.append(['CRPS Values'])\n",
    "    for value in crps_values:\n",
    "        ws_values.append([value])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot ECDF of CRPS values\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "    sns.ecdfplot(crps_values, color='green', linewidth=2)\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('ECDF')\n",
    "    plt.title(f'CRPS ECDF - {model_name}')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save plot to buffer\n",
    "    buffer = io.BytesIO()\n",
    "    buffer\n",
    "    plt.savefig(buffer, format='png')\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    buffer.seek(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Create an Image object\n",
    "    img = openpyxlImage(buffer)\n",
    "    img.width = 640\n",
    "    img.height = 480\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Add image to the plots worksheet\n",
    "    ws_plots.add_image(img, image_positions[3])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Save the workbook\n",
    "    _ensure_parent_dir(excel_file_path)\n",
    "    wb.save(_ensure_parent_dir(excel_file_path))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Return a dictionary of results\n",
    "    results = {\n",
    "        'empirical_quantiles': empirical_quantiles,\n",
    "        'average_interval_lengths': average_interval_lengths,\n",
    "        'coverage_levels': coverage_levels,\n",
    "        'average_nll': average_nll,\n",
    "        'average_crps': average_crps,\n",
    "        'nll_values': nll,\n",
    "        'crps_values': crps_values\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    return results"
   ]
